effect.full: Inflicts regular damage.

descriptions.ja: この技は 使えません 思い出すことが できなくなりますが 技を 忘れることを おすすめします
descriptions.hgss: The foe is hit with a destructive shock wave that always inflicts 20 HP damage.

effect.short: Inflicts 20 points of damage.
effect.full: Inflicts exactly 20 damage.

descriptions.zh: 阻碍对手行动， 之前使出的招式 将在４回合内无法使用。
descriptions.ja: 相手の 動きを とめて 直前に だしていた 技を ４ターンの 間 使えなくする。
descriptions.hgss: For several turns, this move prevents the foe from using the move it last used.

effect.short: Disables the target’s last used move for 1-8 turns.
effect.full: Disables the target’s last used move, preventing its use for 4–7 turns, selected at random, or until the target leaves the field. If the target hasn’t used a move since entering the field, if it tried to use a move this turn and failed, if its last used move has 0 PP remaining, or if it already has a move disabled, this move will fail.

descriptions.zh: 将强酸泼向对手进行攻击。 有时会降低对手的特防。
descriptions.ja: 強い 酸を 相手に かけて 攻撃する。 相手の 特防を さげることが ある。
descriptions.hgss: The foe is attacked with a spray of harsh acid. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

effect.short: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.

descriptions.zh: 向对手发射 小型火焰进行攻击。 有时会让对手陷入灼伤状态。
descriptions.ja: 小さな 炎を 相手に 発射して 攻撃する。 やけど状態に することが ある。
descriptions.hgss: The foe is attacked with small flames. The target may also be left with a burn.

effect.short: Has a chance to burn the target.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target.

descriptions.zh: 向对手发射 烈焰进行攻击。 有时会让对手陷入灼伤状态。
descriptions.ja: 激しい 炎を 相手に 発射して 攻撃する。 やけど状態に することが ある。
descriptions.hgss: The foe is scorched with an intense blast of fire. The target may also be left with a burn.

effect.short: Has a chance to burn the target.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target.

descriptions.zh: 用白雾覆盖身体。 在５回合内不会让对手 降低自己的能力。
descriptions.ja: 白い霧で 体を おおう。 ５ターンの 間 相手に 能力を さげられなく なる。
descriptions.hgss: The user cloaks its body with a white mist that prevents any of its stats from being cut for five turns.

effect.short: Protects the user’s stats from being changed by enemy moves.
effect.full: Pokémon on the user’s side of the field are immune to stat-lowering effects for five turns. Guard Swap, Heart Swap, and Power Swap may still be used. Defog used by an opponent will end this effect.

descriptions.zh: 向对手猛烈地喷射 水流进行攻击。
descriptions.ja: 水を 勢いよく 相手に 発射して 攻撃する。
descriptions.hgss: The foe is blasted with a forceful shot of water.

effect.short: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage.

descriptions.zh: 向对手猛烈地喷射 大量水流进行攻击。
descriptions.ja: 大量の 水を 激しい 勢いで 相手に 発射して 攻撃する。
descriptions.hgss: The foe is blasted by a huge volume of water launched under great pressure.

effect.short: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage.

descriptions.zh: 利用大浪 攻击自己周围所有的宝可梦。
descriptions.ja: 大きな 波で 自分の 周りに いるものを 攻撃する。
descriptions.hgss: It swamps the entire battlefield with a giant wave. It can also be used for crossing water.

effect.short: Inflicts regular damage and can hit Dive users.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. If the target is in the first turn of Dive, this move will hit with double power.

descriptions.zh: 向对手发射 冰冻光束进行攻击。 有时会让对手陷入冰冻状态。
descriptions.ja: 凍える ビームを 相手に 発射して 攻撃する。 こおり状態に することが ある。
descriptions.hgss: The foe is struck with an icy-cold beam of energy. It may also freeze the target solid.

effect.short: Has a chance to freeze the target.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to freeze the target.

descriptions.zh: 将猛烈的暴风雪 刮向对手进行攻击。 有时会让对手陷入冰冻状态。
descriptions.ja: 激しい 吹雪を 相手に 吹きつけて 攻撃する。 こおり状態に することが ある。
descriptions.hgss: A howling blizzard is summoned to strike the foe. It may also freeze the target solid.

effect.short: Has a chance to freeze the target.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to freeze the target. During Hail, this move has 100% accuracy. It also has a (100 - accuracy)% chance to break through the protection of Protect and Detect.

descriptions.zh: 向对手发射 神奇的光线进行攻击。 有时会使对手混乱。
descriptions.ja: 不思議な 光線を 相手に 発射して 攻撃する。 混乱させることが ある。

effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to confuse the target.

descriptions.zh: 向对手发射 虹色光束进行攻击。 有时会降低对手的攻击。

effect.short: Has a chance to lower the target’s Attack by one stage.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Attack by one stage.

descriptions.zh: 向对手发射 强烈的光线进行攻击。 下一回合自己将无法动弹。
descriptions.ja: 強い 光線を 相手に 発射して 攻撃する。 次の ターンは 動けなくなる。
descriptions.hgss: The foe is attacked with a powerful beam. The user must rest on the next turn to regain its energy.

effect.short: User foregoes its next turn to recharge.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. User loses its next turn to "recharge", and cannot attack or switch out during that turn.

descriptions.zh: 用尖锐的喙或角 刺向对手进行攻击。
descriptions.ja: 鋭く とがった くちばしや つので 相手を 突いて 攻撃する。
descriptions.hgss: The foe is jabbed with a sharply pointed beak or horn.

effect.short: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage.

descriptions.zh: 一边旋转，一边将尖喙 刺入对手进行攻击。
descriptions.ja: 回転しながら とがった くちばしを 相手に 突き刺して 攻撃する。
descriptions.hgss: A corkscrewing attack with the sharp beak acting as a drill.

effect.short: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage.

descriptions.zh: 将对手连同自己一起 摔向地面进行攻击。 自己也会受到少许伤害。
descriptions.ja: 地面に 自分ごと 相手を 投げつけて 攻撃する。 自分も 少し ダメージを 受ける。
descriptions.hgss: The user grabs the foe and recklessly dives for the ground. It also hurts the user slightly.

effect.short: User receives 1/4 the damage it inflicts in recoil.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. User takes 1/4 the damage it inflicts in recoil.

descriptions.zh: 用力踢对手的脚， 使其摔倒进行攻击。 对手越重，威力越大。
descriptions.ja: 足を 強く けり 相手を 転ばせて 攻撃する。 相手が 重いほど 威力が あがる。
descriptions.hgss: A powerful low kick that makes the foe fall over. It inflicts greater damage on heavier foes.

effect.short: Inflicts more damage to heavier targets, with a maximum of 120 power.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Power increases with the target’s weight in kilograms, to a maximum of 120. Target’s weight | Power --------------- | ----: Up to 10kg | 20 Up to 25kg | 40 Up to 50kg | 60 Up to 100kg | 80 Up to 200kg | 100 Above 200kg | 120

descriptions.zh: 从对手那里受到 物理攻击的伤害将以 ２倍返还给同一个对手。
descriptions.ja: 相手から 受けた 物理攻撃の ダメージを ２倍に して 同じ 相手に 返す。
descriptions.hgss: A retaliation move that counters any physical attack, inflicting double the damage taken.

effect.short: Inflicts twice the damage the user received from the last physical hit it took.
effect.full: Targets the last opposing Pokémon to hit the user with a physical move this turn. Inflicts twice the damage that move did to the user. If there is no eligible target, this move will fail. Type immunity applies, but other type effects are ignored. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move, nor selected by Assist or Metronome.

descriptions.zh: 利用引力将对手甩飞出去。 给予对手和自己等级相同的伤害。
descriptions.ja: 引力を 使い 投げとばす。 自分の レベルと 同じ ダメージを 相手に 与える。
descriptions.hgss: The foe is thrown using the power of gravity. It inflicts damage equal to the user’s level.

effect.short: Inflicts damage equal to the user’s level.
effect.full: Inflicts damage equal to the user’s level. Type immunity applies, but other type effects are ignored.

descriptions.zh: 使出浑身力气 殴打对手进行攻击。
descriptions.ja: こん身の 力で 相手を なぐりつけて 攻撃する。
descriptions.hgss: The foe is slugged with a punch thrown at maximum power. It can also be used to move boulders.

effect.short: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage.

descriptions.zh: 吸取对手的养分进行攻击。 可以回复给予对手 伤害的一半ＨＰ。
descriptions.ja: 養分を 吸い取り 攻撃する。 相手に 与えた ダメージの 半分の ＨＰを 回復できる。
descriptions.hgss: A nutrient-draining attack. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

effect.short: Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.

descriptions.zh: 吸取对手的养分进行攻击。 可以回复给予对手 伤害的一半ＨＰ。
descriptions.ja: 養分を 吸い取り 攻撃する。 相手に 与えた ダメージの 半分の ＨＰを 回復できる。
descriptions.hgss: A nutrient-draining attack. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

effect.short: Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.

descriptions.zh: 植入寄生种子后，将在每回合 一点一点吸取对手的ＨＰ， 从而用来回复自己的ＨＰ。
descriptions.ja: 植えつけた 相手の ＨＰを 毎ターン 少しだけ 吸い取り 自分の ＨＰを 回復する。
descriptions.hgss: A seed is planted on the foe. It steals some HP from the foe to heal the user on every turn.

effect.short: Seeds the target, stealing HP from it every turn.
effect.full: Plants a seed on the target that drains 1/8 of its max HP at the end of every turn and heals the user for the amount taken. Has no effect on Grass Pokémon. The seed remains until the target leaves the field. The user takes damage instead of being healed if the target has Liquid Ooze. Rapid Spin will remove this effect. This effect is passed on by Baton Pass.

descriptions.zh: 让身体一下子长大， 从而提高攻击和特攻。
descriptions.ja: 体を 一気に 大きく 生長させて 攻撃と 特攻を あげる。
descriptions.hgss: The user’s body is forced to grow all at once. It raises the Sp. Atk stat.

effect.short: Raises the user’s Special Attack by one stage.
effect.full: Raises the user’s Special Attack by one stage.

descriptions.zh: 飞出叶片， 切斩对手进行攻击。 容易击中要害。
descriptions.ja: はっぱを とばして 相手を 切りつけて 攻撃する。 急所に 当たりやすい。
descriptions.hgss: Sharp-edged leaves are launched to slash at the foe. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

effect.short: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

descriptions.zh: 第１回合收集满满的日光， 第２回合发射光束进行攻击。
descriptions.ja: １ターン目に 光を いっぱいに 集め ２ターン目に 光の 束を 発射して 攻撃する。
descriptions.hgss: A two-turn attack. The user gathers light, then blasts a bundled beam on the second turn.

effect.short: Requires a turn to charge before attacking.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. User charges for one turn before attacking. During Sunny Day, the charge turn is skipped. During Hail, Rain Dance, or Sandstorm, power is halved. This move cannot be selected by Sleep Talk.

descriptions.zh: 撒出毒粉， 从而让对手陷入中毒状态。
descriptions.ja: 毒の ある 粉を たくさん ふりまいて 相手を 毒状態に する。
descriptions.hgss: A cloud of poisonous dust is scattered on the foe. It may poison the target.

effect.short: Poisons the target.
effect.full: Poisons the target.

descriptions.zh: 撒出麻痹粉， 从而让对手陷入麻痹状态。
descriptions.ja: しびれる 粉を たくさん ふりまいて 相手を まひ状態に する。
descriptions.hgss: The user scatters a cloud of paralyzing powder. It may paralyze the target.

effect.short: Paralyzes the target.
effect.full: Paralyzes the target.

descriptions.zh: 撒出催眠粉， 从而让对手陷入睡眠状态。
descriptions.ja: 眠くなる 粉を たくさん ふりまいて 相手を 眠り状態に する。
descriptions.hgss: The user scatters a big cloud of sleep- inducing dust around the foe.

effect.short: Puts the target to sleep.
effect.full: Puts the target to sleep.

descriptions.zh: 在２～３回合内， 散落花瓣攻击对手。 之后自己会陷入混乱。
descriptions.ja: ２ー３ターンの 間 花を まきちらして 相手を 攻撃する。 まきちらした あとは 混乱する。
descriptions.hgss: The user attacks by scattering petals for two to three turns. The user then becomes confused.

effect.short: Hits every turn for 2-3 turns, then confuses the user.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. User is forced to attack with this move for 2–3 turns,selected at random. After the last hit, the user becomes confused. Safeguard does not protect against the confusion from this move.

descriptions.zh: 用口中吐出的丝缠绕对手， 从而大幅降低对手的速度。
descriptions.ja: 口から 吹きだした 糸を まきつけて 相手の 素早さを がくっと さげる。
descriptions.hgss: The foe is bound with silk blown from the user’s mouth. It reduces the target’s Speed stat.

effect.short: Lowers the target’s Speed by one stage.
effect.full: Lowers the target’s Speed by one stage.

descriptions.hgss: The foe is stricken by a shock wave. This attack always inflicts 40 HP damage.

effect.short: Inflicts 40 points of damage.
effect.full: Inflicts exactly 40 damage.

descriptions.zh: 将对手困在 激烈的火焰旋涡中， 在４～５回合内进行攻击。
descriptions.ja: 激しく 渦をまく 炎の中に ４ー５ターンの 間 相手を 閉じこめて 攻撃する。
descriptions.hgss: The foe becomes trapped within a fierce vortex of fire that rages for two to five turns.

effect.short: Prevents the target from fleeing and inflicts damage for 2-5 turns.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. For the next 2–5 turns, the target cannot leave the field and is damaged for 1/16 its max HP at the end of each turn. The user continues to use other moves during this time. If the user leaves the field, this effect ends. Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use. Rapid Spin cancels this effect.

descriptions.zh: 发出电流刺激对手进行攻击。 有时会让对手陷入麻痹状态。
descriptions.ja: 電気の 刺激を 相手に 浴びせて 攻撃する。 まひ状態に することが ある。

effect.short: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target.

descriptions.zh: 向对手发出 强力电击进行攻击。 有时会让对手陷入麻痹状态。
descriptions.ja: 強い 電撃を 相手に 浴びせて 攻撃する。 まひ状態に することが ある。
descriptions.hgss: A strong electric blast is loosed at the foe. It may also leave the foe paralyzed.

effect.short: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target.

descriptions.zh: 向对手发出 微弱的电击， 从而让对手陷入麻痹状态。
descriptions.ja: 弱い 電撃を 浴びせることで 相手を まひ状態に する。
descriptions.hgss: A weak electric charge is launched at the foe. It causes paralysis if it hits.

effect.short: Paralyzes the target.
effect.full: Paralyzes the target.

descriptions.zh: 向对手劈下暴雷进行攻击。 有时会让对手陷入麻痹状态。
descriptions.ja: 激しい 雷を 相手に 落として 攻撃する。 まひ状態に することが ある。
descriptions.hgss: A wicked thunderbolt is dropped on the foe to inflict damage. It may also leave the target paralyzed.

effect.short: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target. During Rain Dance, this move has 100% accuracy. It also has a (100 - accuracy)% chance to break through the protection of Protect and Detect. During Sunny Day, this move has 50% accuracy.

descriptions.zh: 拿起小岩石， 投掷对手进行攻击。
descriptions.ja: 小さな 岩を 持ちあげて 相手に 投げつけて 攻撃する。
descriptions.hgss: The user picks up and throws a small rock at the foe to attack.

effect.short: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage.

descriptions.zh: 利用地震的冲击， 攻击自己周围所有的宝可梦。
descriptions.ja: 地震の 衝撃で 自分の 周りに いるものを 攻撃する。
descriptions.hgss: The user sets off an earthquake that hits all the Pokémon in the battle.

effect.short: Inflicts regular damage and can hit Dig users.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. If the target is in the first turn of Dig, this move will hit with double power.

descriptions.zh: 让对手掉落于地裂的 裂缝中进行攻击。 只要命中就会一击濒死。
descriptions.ja: 地割れの 裂け目に 相手を 落として 攻撃する。 当たれば 一撃で ひんしに する。
descriptions.hgss: The user opens up a fissure in the ground and drops the foe in. The target instantly faints if it hits.

effect.short: Causes a one-hit KO.
effect.full: Inflicts damage equal to the target’s max HP. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. This move’s accuracy is 30% plus 1% for each level the user is higher than the target. If the user is a lower level than the target, this move will fail. Because this move inflicts a specific and finite amount of damage, Endure still prevents the target from fainting. The effects of Lock-On, Mind Reader, and No Guard still apply, as long as the user is equal or higher level than the target. However, they will not give this move a chance to break through Detect or Protect.

descriptions.zh: 第１回合钻入， 第２回合攻击对手。
descriptions.ja: １ターン目に 潜り ２ターン目で 相手を 攻撃する。
descriptions.hgss: The user burrows, then attacks on the second turn. It can also be used to exit dungeons.

effect.short: User digs underground, dodging all attacks, and hits next turn.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. User digs underground for one turn, becoming immune to attack, and hits on the second turn. During the immune turn, Earthquake, Fissure, and Magnitude still hit the user normally, and their power is doubled if appropriate. The user may be hit during its immune turn if under the effect of Lock-On, Mind Reader, or No Guard. This move cannot be selected by Sleep Talk.

descriptions.zh: 让对手陷入剧毒状态。 随着回合的推进， 中毒伤害会增加。
descriptions.ja: 相手を 猛毒の 状態に する。 ターンが すすむほど 毒の ダメージが 増えていく。
descriptions.hgss: A move that leaves the target badly poisoned. Its poison damage worsens every turn.

effect.short: Badly poisons the target, inflicting more damage every turn.
effect.full: Badly poisons the target. Never misses when used by a Poison-type Pokémon.

descriptions.zh: 向对手发送 微弱的念力进行攻击。 有时会使对手混乱。

descriptions.hgss: The foe is hit by a weak telekinetic force. It may also leave the foe confused.

effect.short: Has a chance to confuse the target.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to confuse the target.

descriptions.ja: 強い 念力を 相手に 送って 攻撃する。 相手の 特防を さげることが ある。
descriptions.hgss: The foe is hit by a strong telekinetic force. It may also reduce the foe’s Sp. Def stat.

effect.short: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.

descriptions.zh: 施以诱导睡意的暗示， 让对手陷入睡眠状态。
descriptions.ja: 眠気を 誘う 暗示を かけて 相手を 眠り状態に する。
descriptions.hgss: The user employs hypnotic suggestion to make the target fall into a deep sleep.

effect.short: Puts the target to sleep.
effect.full: Puts the target to sleep.

descriptions.hgss: The user meditates to awaken the power deep within its body and raise its Attack stat.

effect.short: Raises the user’s Attack by one stage.

effect.full: Selects any move at random and uses it. Moves the user already knows are not eligible. descriptions.zh: 削减少许自己的ＨＰ， 制造分身。 分身将成为自己的替身。
descriptions.ja: 自分の ＨＰを 少し 削って 分身を だす。 分身は 自分の 身代わりに なる。
descriptions.hgss: The user makes a copy of itself using some of its HP. The copy serves as the user’s decoy.

effect.short: Transfers 1/4 of the user’s max HP into a doll, protecting the user from further damage or status changes until it breaks.
effect.full: Transfers 1/4 the user’s max HP into a doll that absorbs damage and causes most negative move effects to fail. If the user leaves the field, the doll will vanish. If the user cannot pay the HP cost, this move will fail. The doll takes damage as normal, using the user’s stats and types, and will break when its HP reaches zero. Self-inflicted damage from confusion or recoil is not absorbed. Healing effects from opponents ignore the doll and heal the user as normal. Moves that work based on the user’s HP still do so; the doll’s HP does not influence any move. The doll will block major status effects, confusion, and flinching. The effects of Smelling Salts and Wake-Up Slap do not trigger against a doll, even if the Pokémon behind the doll has the appropriate major status effect. Multi-turn trapping moves like Wrap will hit the doll for their regular damage, but the multi-turn trapping and damage effects will not activate. Moves blocked or damage absorbed by the doll do not count as hitting the user or inflicting damage for any effects that respond to such, e.g., Avalanche, Counter, or a Rowap Berry. Magic Coat still works as normal, even against moves the doll would block. Opposing Pokémon that damage the doll with a leech move like Absorb are healed as normal. It will also block Acupressure, Block, the curse effect of Curse, Dream Eater, Embargo, Flatter, Gastro Acid, Grudge, Heal Block, Leech Seed, Lock-On, Mean Look, Mimic, Mind Reader, Nightmare, Pain Split, Psycho Shift, Spider Web, Sketch, Swagger, Switcheroo, Trick, Worry Seed, and Yawn. A Pokémon affected by Yawn before summoning the doll will still fall to sleep. The doll blocks Intimidate, but all other abilities act as though the doll did not exist. If the user has an ability that absorbs moves of a certain type for HP (such as Volt Absorb absorbing Thunder Wave), such moves will not be blocked. Life Orb and berries that cause confusion still work as normal, but their respective HP loss and confusion are absorbed/blocked by the doll. The user is still vulnerable to damage inflicted when entering or leaving the field, such as by Pursuit or Spikes; however, the doll will block the poison effect of Toxic Spikes. The doll is passed on by Baton Pass. It keeps its existing HP, but uses the replacement Pokémon’s stats and types for damage calculation. All other effects work as normal.

descriptions.zh: 当自己的ＰＰ耗尽时， 努力挣扎攻击对手。 自己也会受到少许伤害。
descriptions.ja: 自分の ＰＰが なくなると あがいて 相手を 攻撃する。 自分も 少し ダメージを 受ける。
descriptions.hgss: An attack that is used in desperation only if the user has no PP. It also hurts the user slightly.

effect.short: User takes 1/4 its max HP in recoil.
effect.full: Inflicts typeless regular damage. User takes 1/4 its max HP in recoil. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. This move is used automatically when a Pokémon cannot use any other move legally, e.g., due to having no PP remaining or being under the effect of both Encore and Torment at the same time. This move’s recoil is not treated as recoil for the purposes of anything that affects recoil, such as the ability Rock Head. It also is not prevented by Magic Guard. This move cannot be copied by Mimic, Mirror Move, or Sketch, nor selected by Assist or Metronome, nor forced by Encore.

descriptions.ja: 相手が 使った 技を 自分の ものに する。 １回 使うと スケッチは 消える。

effect.short: Permanently becomes the target’s last used move.
effect.full: Permanently replaces itself with the target’s last used move. If that move is Chatter or Struggle, this move will fail. This move cannot be copied by Mimic or Mirror Move, nor selected by Assist or Metronome, nor forced by Encore.

effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Hits three times in the same turn. The second hit has double power, and the third hit has triple power. Each hit has a separate accuracy check, and this move stops if a hit misses. Skill Link does not apply.

effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. If the target is holding an item and the user is not, the user will permanently take the item. Damage is still inflicted if an item cannot be taken. Pokémon with Sticky Hold or Multitype are immune to the item theft effect. The target cannot recover its item with Recycle. This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome.

effect.full: If the user targets the same target again before the end of the next turn, the move it uses is guaranteed to hit. This move itself also ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. descriptions.zh: 让火焰覆盖全身， 猛撞向对手进行攻击。 有时会让对手陷入灼伤状态。
descriptions.ja: 炎を まとい 相手に 突進して 攻撃する。 やけど状態に することが ある。

effect.short: Inflicts more damage when the user has less HP remaining, with a maximum of 200 power.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Power varies inversely with the user’s proportional remaining HP. 64 * current HP / max HP | Power -----------------------: | ----: 0– 1 | 200 2– 5 | 150 6–12 | 100 13–21 | 80 22–42 | 40 43–64 | 20

descriptions.zh: 对对手最后使用的招式 怀有怨恨， 减少４ＰＰ该招式。
descriptions.ja: 相手が 最後に 使った技に 恨みを 抱いて その技の ＰＰを ４だけ 減らす。
descriptions.hgss: The user looses its grudge on the move last used by the foe by cutting 4 PP from it.

effect.short: Lowers the PP of the target’s last used move by 4.
effect.full: Lowers the PP of the target’s last used move by 4. If the target hasn’t used a move since entering the field, if it tried to use a move this turn and failed, or if its last used move has 0 PP remaining, this move will fail.

descriptions.zh: 将冰冷的细雪 吹向对手进行攻击。 有时会让对手陷入冰冻状态。
descriptions.ja: 冷たい 粉雪を 相手に 吹きつけて 攻撃する。 こおり状態に することが ある。
descriptions.hgss: The user attacks with a chilling gust of powdery snow. It may also freeze the target.

effect.short: Has a chance to freeze the target.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to freeze the target.

descriptions.zh: 完全抵挡 对手的攻击。 连续使出则容易失败。
descriptions.ja: 相手の 攻撃を まったく 受けない。 連続で だすと 失敗しやすい。
descriptions.hgss: It enables the user to evade all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

effect.short: Prevents any moves from hitting the user this turn.
effect.full: No moves will hit the user for the remainder of this turn. If the user is last to act this turn, this move will fail. If the user successfully used Detect, Endure, Protect, Quick Guard, or Wide Guard on the last turn, this move has a 50% chance to fail. Lock-On, Mind Reader, and No Guard provide a (100 – accuracy)% chance for moves to break through this move. This does not apply to one-hit KO moves (Fissure, Guillotine, Horn Drill, and Sheer Cold); those are always blocked by this move. Thunder during Rain Dance and Blizzard during Hail have a 30% chance to break through this move. The following effects are not prevented by this move: * Acupressure from an ally * Curse’s curse effect * Delayed damage from Doom Desire and Future Sight; however, these moves will be prevented if they are used this turn * Feint, which will also end this move’s protection after it hits * Imprison * Perish Song * Shadow Force * Moves that merely copy the user, such as Transform or Psych Up This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome.

descriptions.zh: 以迅雷不及掩耳之势出拳。 必定能够先制攻击。
descriptions.ja: 目にも 留まらぬ ものすごい 速さで パンチを くりだす。 必ず 先制攻撃 できる。
descriptions.hgss: The user throws a punch at blinding speed. It is certain to strike first.

effect.short: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage.

descriptions.zh: 用恐怖的表情瞪着对手， 使其害怕， 从而大幅降低对手的速度。
descriptions.ja: 恐ろしい 顔で にらみ おびえさせて 相手の 素早さを がくっと さげる。
descriptions.hgss: The user frightens the foe with a scary face to sharply reduce its Speed stat.

effect.short: Lowers the target’s Speed by two stages.
effect.full: Lowers the target’s Speed by two stages.

descriptions.zh: 无法使用这个招式。 虽然忘记之后就再也想不起来了， 但还是建议忘记这个招式。
descriptions.ja: この技は 使えません 思い出すことが できなくなりますが 技を 忘れることを おすすめします
descriptions.hgss: The user draws up to the foe disarmingly, then throws a sucker punch. It hits without fail.

effect.short: Never misses.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

descriptions.zh: 像天使般可爱地亲吻对手， 从而使对手混乱。
descriptions.ja: 天使のように かわいく キスして 相手を 混乱させる。
descriptions.hgss: The user kisses the foe with a sweet, angelic cuteness that causes confusion.

effect.short: Confuses the target.
effect.full: Confuses the target.

descriptions.zh: 将自己的ＨＰ减少到 最大ＨＰ的一半， 从而最大限度提高自己的攻击。
descriptions.ja: 自分の ＨＰを 最大ＨＰの 半分 減らして 自分の 攻撃を 最大に あげる。
descriptions.hgss: The user maximizes its Attack stat in exchange for HP equal to half its max HP.

effect.short: User pays half its max HP to max out its Attack.
effect.full: User pays half its max HP to raise its Attack to +6 stages. If the user cannot pay the HP cost, this move will fail.

descriptions.zh: 用污泥投掷对手进行攻击。 有时会让对手陷入中毒状态。
descriptions.ja: 汚い ヘドロを 相手に 投げつけて 攻撃する。 毒状態に することが ある。
descriptions.hgss: The user attacks by hurling filthy sludge at the foe. It may also poison the target.

effect.short: Has a chance to poison the target.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to poison the target.

descriptions.zh: 向对手的脸等 投掷泥块进行攻击。 会降低对手的命中率。
descriptions.ja: 相手の 顔などに 泥を 投げつけて 攻撃する。 命中率を さげる。
descriptions.hgss: The user hurls mud in the foe’s face to inflict damage and lower its accuracy.

effect.short: Has a chance to lower the target’s accuracy by one stage.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s accuracy by one stage.

descriptions.zh: 向对手的脸等 喷出墨汁进行攻击。 有时会降低对手的命中率。
descriptions.ja: 相手の 顔などに 墨を 吹きかけて 攻撃する。 命中率を さげることが ある。
descriptions.hgss: The user attacks by spraying ink in the foe’s face or eyes. It may also lower the target’s accuracy.

effect.short: Has a chance to lower the target’s accuracy by one stage.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s accuracy by one stage.

descriptions.zh: 在对手的脚下扔撒菱。 对替换出场的对手的宝可梦 给予伤害。
descriptions.ja: 相手の 足下に まきびしを しかける。交代で でてきた 相手の ポケモンに ダメージを 与える。
descriptions.hgss: The user lays a trap of spikes at the foe’s feet. The trap hurts foes that switch into battle.

effect.short: Scatters Spikes, hurting opposing Pokémon that switch in.
effect.full: Scatters spikes around the opposing field, which damage opposing Pokémon that enter the field for 1/8 of their max HP. Pokémon immune to Ground moves are immune to this damage, except during Gravity. Up to three layers of spikes may be laid down, adding 1/16 to the damage done: two layers of spikes damage for 3/16 max HP, and three layers damage for 1/4 max HP. Wonder Guard does not block damage from this effect. Rapid Spin removes this effect from its user’s side of the field. Defog removes this effect from its target’s side of the field.

descriptions.zh: 发射大炮一样的 电流进行攻击。 让对手陷入麻痹状态。
descriptions.ja: 大砲の ような 電気を 発射して 攻撃する。 相手を まひの 状態に する。
descriptions.hgss: The user fires an electric blast like a cannon to inflict damage and cause paralysis.

effect.short: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target.

descriptions.zh: 无法使用这个招式。 虽然忘记之后就再也想不起来了， 但还是建议忘记这个招式。
descriptions.ja: この技は 使えません 思い出すことが できなくなりますが 技を 忘れることを おすすめします
descriptions.hgss: Enables the user to hit a Ghost type with any type of move. It also enables the user to hit an evasive foe.

effect.short: Forces the target to have no Evade, and allows it to be hit by Normal and Fighting moves even if it’s a Ghost.
effect.full: Resets the target’s evasion to normal and prevents any further boosting until the target leaves the field. A Ghost under this effect takes normal damage from Normal and Fighting moves. This move itself ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

descriptions.zh: 使出招式后，当受到对手攻击 陷入濒死时，对手也会一同濒死。 连续使出则会失败。
descriptions.ja: 技のあと 相手の 攻撃で ひんしに なると 攻撃 相手も ひんしにする。 連続して 出すと 失敗する。
descriptions.hgss: When this move is used, if the user faints, the foe that landed the knockout hit also faints.

effect.short: If the user faints this turn, the target automatically will, too.
effect.full: If the user faints before its next move, the Pokémon that fainted it will automatically faint. End-of-turn damage is ignored. This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome.

descriptions.zh: 倾听歌声的宝可梦 经过３回合陷入濒死。 替换后效果消失。
descriptions.ja: 歌を 聴いた ポケモンは ３ターン たつと ひんしに なる。 交代すると 効果は なくなる。
descriptions.hgss: Any Pokémon that hears this song faints in three turns, unless it switches out of battle.

effect.short: User and target both faint after three turns.
effect.full: Every Pokémon is given a counter that starts at 3 and decreases by 1 at the end of every turn, including this one. When a Pokémon’s counter reaches zero, that Pokémon faints. A Pokémon that leaves the field will lose its counter; its replacement does not inherit the effect, and other Pokémon’s counters remain. This effect is passed on by Baton Pass. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move.

descriptions.zh: 将结冰的冷气 吹向对手进行攻击。 会降低对手的速度。
descriptions.ja: 凍てつく 冷気を 相手に 吹きつけて 攻撃する。 相手の 素早さを さげる。
descriptions.hgss: The user attacks with a gust of chilled air. It also lowers the target’s Speed stat.

effect.short: Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.

descriptions.ja: 相手の 攻撃を まったく 受けない。 連続で だすと 失敗しやすい。

effect.full: No moves will hit the user for the remainder of this turn. If the user is last to act this turn, this move will fail. Lock-On, Mind Reader, and No Guard provide a (100 – accuracy)% chance for moves to break through this move. descriptions.zh: 用坚硬的骨头 殴打对手进行攻击。 连续攻击２～５次。
descriptions.ja: 硬い ホネで 相手を なぐりつけて 攻撃する。 ２ー５回の 間 連続で だす。
descriptions.hgss: The user strikes at the foe with a hard bone two to five times in a row.

effect.short: Hits 2-5 times in one turn.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Hits 2–5 times in one turn. Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use.

descriptions.zh: 紧紧瞄准对手， 下次攻击必定会打中。
descriptions.ja: 照準を しっかり あわせて 次の 攻撃が 必ず 相手に 当たるように する。
descriptions.hgss: The user takes sure aim at the foe. It ensures the next attack does not fail to hit the target.

effect.short: Ensures that the user’s next move will hit the target.
effect.full: If the user targets the same target again before the end of the next turn, the move it uses is guaranteed to hit. This move itself also ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. One-hit KO moves are also guaranteed to hit, as long as the user is equal or higher level than the target. This effect also allows the user to hit Pokémon that are off the field due to moves such as Dig or Fly. If the target uses Detect or Protect while under the effect of this move, the user is not guaranteed to hit, but has a (100 - accuracy)% chance to break through the protection. This effect is passed on by Baton Pass.

descriptions.zh: 在２～３回合内， 乱打一气地进行攻击。 大闹一番后自己会陷入混乱。
descriptions.ja: ２ー３ターンの 間 暴れまくって 攻撃する。 暴れたあとは 混乱する。
descriptions.hgss: The user rampages and attacks for two to three turns. However, it then becomes confused.

effect.short: Hits every turn for 2-3 turns, then confuses the user.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. User is forced to attack with this move for 2–3 turns,selected at random. After the last hit, the user becomes confused. Safeguard does not protect against the confusion from this move.

descriptions.zh: 在５回合内扬起沙暴，除岩石、地面和 钢属性以外的宝可梦，都会受到伤害。 岩石属性的特防还会提高。
descriptions.ja: ５ターンの 間 砂あらしで いわ じめん はがねタイプ 以外に ダメージ。 いわタイプの 特防が あがる。
descriptions.hgss: A five-turn sand­ storm is summoned to hurt all combatant types except Rock, Ground, and Steel.

effect.short: Changes the weather to a sandstorm for five turns.
effect.full: Changes the weather to a sandstorm for five turns. Pokémon that are not Ground, Rock, or Steel take 1/16 their max HP at the end of every turn. Every Rock Pokémon’s original Special Defense is raised by 50% for the duration of this effect. Solar Beam’s power is halved. Moonlight, Morning Sun, and Synthesis only heal 1/4 the user’s max HP.

descriptions.zh: 吸取对手的养分进行攻击。 可以回复给予对手 伤害的一半ＨＰ。
descriptions.ja: 養分を 吸い取り 攻撃する。 与えた ダメージの 半分の ＨＰを 回復できる。
descriptions.hgss: A nutrient-draining attack. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

effect.short: Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.

descriptions.zh: 即使受到攻击， 也至少会留下１ＨＰ。 连续使出则容易失败。
descriptions.ja: 攻撃を 受けても ＨＰを 必ず １だけ 残せる。 連続で だすと 失敗しやすい。
descriptions.hgss: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

effect.short: Prevents the user’s HP from lowering below 1 this turn.
effect.full: The user’s HP cannot be lowered below 1 by any means for the remainder of this turn. If the user successfully used Detect, Endure, Protect, Quick Guard, or Wide Guard on the last turn, this move has a 50% chance to fail. This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome.

descriptions.zh: 可爱地凝视， 诱使对手疏忽大意， 从而大幅降低对手的攻击。
descriptions.ja: かわいく みつめて 油断を 誘い 相手の 攻撃を がくっと さげる。
descriptions.hgss: The user charmingly stares at the foe, making it less wary. The target’s Attack is sharply lowered.

effect.short: Lowers the target’s Attack by two stages.
effect.full: Lowers the target’s Attack by two stages.

descriptions.zh: 在５回合内连续滚动攻击对手。 招式每次击中，威力就会提高。
descriptions.ja: ５ターンの 間 転がり続けて 攻撃する。 技が 当たるたびに 威力が あがる。
descriptions.hgss: The user continually rolls into the foe over five turns. It becomes stronger each time it hits.

effect.short: Power doubles every turn this move is used in succession after the first, resetting after five turns.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. User is forced to use this move for five turns. Power doubles every time this move is used in succession to a maximum of 16x, and resets to normal after the lock-in ends. If this move misses or becomes unusable, the lock-in ends. If the user has used Defense Curl since entering the field, this move has double power.

descriptions.zh: 对手的ＨＰ 至少会留下１ＨＰ， 如此般手下留情地攻击。
descriptions.ja: 相手の ＨＰが 必ず １だけ 残るように 手加減して 攻撃する。
descriptions.hgss: A restrained attack that prevents the foe from fainting. The target is left with at least 1 HP.

effect.short: Cannot lower the target’s HP below 1.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Will not reduce the target’s HP below 1.

descriptions.zh: 激怒对手，使其混乱。 因为愤怒，对手的攻击 会大幅提高。
descriptions.ja: 相手を 怒らせて 混乱させる。 怒りで 相手の 攻撃は ぐーんと あがってしまう。
descriptions.hgss: The user enrages the foe into confusion. However, it also sharply raises the foe’s Attack stat.

effect.short: Raises the target’s Attack by two stages and confuses the target.
effect.full: Raises the target’s Attack by two stages, then confuses it. If the target’s Attack cannot be raised by two stages, the confusion is not applied.

descriptions.zh: 回复自己最大ＨＰ的一半。
descriptions.ja: 最大ＨＰの 半分 自分の ＨＰを 回復する。
descriptions.hgss: The user restores its own HP by up to half of its maximum HP. It may also be used to heal an ally’s HP.

effect.short: Heals the user by half its max HP.
effect.full: Heals the user for half its max HP.

descriptions.zh: 让电流覆盖全身， 猛撞向对手进行攻击。 有时会让对手陷入麻痹状态。
descriptions.ja: 電気を まとい 相手に 突進して 攻撃する。 まひ状態に することが ある。
descriptions.hgss: The user throws an electrically charged tackle at the foe. It may also leave the target paralyzed.

effect.short: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target.

descriptions.zh: 用镰刀或爪子等 切斩对手进行攻击。 连续击中，威力就会提高。
descriptions.ja: カマや ツメなどで 相手を 切りつけて 攻撃する。 連続で 当てると 威力が あがる。
descriptions.hgss: The foe is slashed with scythes or claws. Its power increases if it hits in succession.

effect.short: Power doubles every turn this move is used in succession after the first, maxing out after five turns.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Power doubles after every time this move is used, whether consecutively or not, maxing out at 16x. If this move misses or the user leaves the field, power resets.

descriptions.zh: 用坚硬的翅膀敲打 对手进行攻击。 有时会提高自己的防御。
descriptions.ja: 硬い 翼を 相手に たたきつけて 攻撃する。 自分の 防御が あがることが ある。
descriptions.hgss: The foe is hit with wings of steel. It may also raise the user’s Defense stat.

effect.short: Has a chance to raise the user’s Defense by one stage.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to raise the user’s Defense one stage.

descriptions.zh: 用好似要勾人心魂的黑色目光 一动不动地凝视对手， 使其不能从战斗中逃走。
descriptions.ja: 吸いこまれるような 黒い まなざしで じっと みつめて 相手を 戦闘から 逃げられなくする。
descriptions.hgss: The user affixes the foe with a dark, arresting look. The target becomes unable to flee.

effect.short: Prevents the target from leaving battle.
effect.full: The target cannot switch out normally. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. This effect ends when the user leaves the field. The target may still escape by using Baton Pass, U-turn, or a Shed Shell. Both the user and the target pass on this effect with Baton Pass.

descriptions.zh: ♂诱惑♀或♀诱惑♂， 让对手着迷。 对手将很难使出招式。
descriptions.ja: ♂なら♀を ♀なら♂を 誘惑して メロメロに する。 相手は 技が だしにくくなる。
descriptions.hgss: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the foe becomes infatuated and less likely to attack.

effect.short: Target falls in love if it has the opposite gender, and has a 50% chance to refuse attacking the user.
effect.full: Causes the target to fall in love with the user, giving it a 50% chance to do nothing each turn. If the user and target are the same gender, or either is genderless, this move will fail. If either Pokémon leaves the field, this effect ends.

descriptions.zh: 从自己已学会的招式中 任意使出１个。 只能在自己睡觉时使用。
descriptions.ja: 自分が おぼえている 技の うち どれか １つを くりだす。 自分が 寝ているときだけ 使える。
descriptions.hgss: While it is asleep, the user randomly uses one of the moves it knows.

effect.short: Randomly uses one of the user’s other three moves. Only works if the user is sleeping.
effect.full: Only usable if the user is sleeping. Randomly selects and uses one of the user’s other three moves. Use of the selected move requires and costs 0 PP. This move will not select Assist, Bide, Bounce, Chatter, Copycat, Dig, Dive, Fly, Focus Punch, Me First, Metronome, Mirror Move, Shadow Force, Skull Bash, Sky Attack, Sky Drop, Sleep Talk, Solar Beam, Razor Wind, or Uproar. If the selected move requires a recharge turn—i.e., one of Blast Burn, Frenzy Plant, Giga Impact, Hydro Cannon, Hyper Beam, Roar of Time, or Rock Wrecker—and the user is still sleeping next turn, then it’s forced to use this move again and pay another PP for the recharge turn. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move, nor selected by Assist, Metronome, or Sleep Talk.

descriptions.zh: 让同伴听舒适的铃音， 从而治愈我方全员的异常状态。
descriptions.ja: 心地好い 鈴の 音色を 聞かせて 味方 全員の 状態異常を 回復 する。
descriptions.hgss: The user makes a soothing bell chime to heal the status problems of all the party Pokémon.

effect.short: Cures the entire party of major status effects.
effect.full: Removes major status effects and confusion from every Pokémon in the user’s party.

descriptions.zh: 无法使用这个招式。 虽然忘记之后就再也想不起来了， 但还是建议忘记这个招式。
descriptions.ja: この技は 使えません 思い出すことが できなくなりますが 技を 忘れることを おすすめします
descriptions.hgss: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the more the user likes its Trainer.

effect.short: Power increases with happiness, up to a maximum of 102.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Power increases with happiness, given by `happiness * 2 / 5`, to a maximum of 102. Power bottoms out at 1.

descriptions.zh: 递给对手设有圈套的 盒子进行攻击。 也有可能回复对手ＨＰ。
descriptions.ja: わなを しかけた 箱を 相手に わたして 攻撃する。ＨＰが 回復して しまうことも ある。
descriptions.hgss: The user attacks by giving the foe a booby-trapped gift. It restores HP sometimes, however.

effect.short: Randomly inflicts damage with power from 40 to 120 or heals the target for 1/4 its max HP.
effect.full: Randomly uses one of the following effects. Effect | Chance -------------------------------------------------- | -----: Inflicts regular damage with 40 power | 40% Inflicts regular damage with 80 power | 30% Inflicts regular damage with 120 power | 10% Heals the target for 1/4 its max HP | 20% On average, this move inflicts regular damage with 52 power and heals the target for 1/20 its max HP.

descriptions.zh: 无法使用这个招式。 虽然忘记之后就再也想不起来了， 但还是建议忘记这个招式。

descriptions.hgss: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the less the user likes its Trainer.

effect.short: Power increases as happiness decreases, up to a maximum of 102.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Power increases inversely with happiness, given by `(255 - happiness) * 2 / 5`, to a maximum of 102. Power bottoms out at 1.

descriptions.zh: 在５回合内 被神奇的力量守护， 从而不会陷入异常状态。

descriptions.hgss: The user creates a protective field that prevents status problems for five turns.

effect.short: Protects the user’s field from major status ailments and confusion for five turns.
effect.full: Protects Pokémon on the user’s side of the field from major status effects and confusion for five turns. Does not cancel existing ailments. This effect remains even if the user leaves the field. If Yawn is used while this move is in effect, it will immediately fail. Defog used by an opponent will end this effect. This effect does not prevent the confusion caused by Outrage, Petal Dance, or Thrash.

descriptions.zh: 将自己的ＨＰ和 对手的ＨＰ相加， 然后自己和对手友好地平分。

descriptions.hgss: The user adds its HP to the foe’s HP, then equally shares the combined HP with the foe.

effect.short: Sets the user’s and targets’s HP to the average of their current HP.
effect.full: Changes the user’s and target’s remaining HP to the average of their current remaining HP. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. This effect does not count as inflicting damage for other moves and effects that respond to damage taken. This effect fails against a Substitute.

descriptions.zh: 用神秘的火焰 烧尽对手进行攻击。 有时会让对手陷入灼伤状态。
descriptions.ja: 神秘の 炎で 相手を 焼きつくして 攻撃する。 やけど状態に することが ある。
descriptions.hgss: The foe is razed with a mystical fire of great intensity. It may also leave the target with a burn.

effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target. Frozen Pokémon may use this move, in which case they will thaw.

descriptions.zh: 使出浑身力气出拳进行攻击。 必定会使对手混乱。
descriptions.ja: こん身の 力で パンチを くりだして 攻撃する。 相手を 必ず 混乱させる。
descriptions.hgss: The foe is punched with the user’s full, concentrated power. It confuses the foe if it hits.

effect.short: Has a chance to confuse the target.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to confuse the target.

descriptions.zh: 用坚硬且华丽的角狠狠地 刺入对手进行攻击。
descriptions.ja: 硬くて りっぱな つので おもいっきり 相手を 突き刺して 攻撃する。
descriptions.hgss: Using its tough and impressive horn, the user rams into the foe with no letup.

effect.short: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage.

descriptions.zh: 将强烈的气息 吹向对手进行攻击。 有时会让对手陷入麻痹状态。
descriptions.ja: ものすごい 息を 相手に 吹きつけて 攻撃する。 まひ状態に することが ある。
descriptions.hgss: The user exhales a mighty gust that inflicts damage. It may also paralyze the target.

effect.short: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target.

descriptions.ja: 控えの ポケモンと 入れ替わる。 能力変化は 替わった ポケモンが そのまま 受けつぐ。
descriptions.hgss: The user switches places with a party Pokémon in waiting, passing along any stat changes.

effect.short: Allows the trainer to switch out the user and pass effects along to its replacement.
effect.full: User switches out, and the trainer selects a replacement Pokémon from the party. Stat changes, confusion, and persistent move effects are passed along to the replacement Pokémon. The following move effects are passed: * Aqua Ring * both the user’s and target’s effect of Block, Mean Look, and Spider Web * the curse effect of Curse * Embargo * Focus Energy or an activated Lansat Berry * Gastro Acid * Ingrain * being sapped by Leech Seed * being targeted by Lock-On or Mind Reader * Magnet Rise * Perish Song’s counter * Power Trick * Substitute; the doll’s HP is unchanged The replacement Pokémon does not trigger effects that respond to Pokémon switching in.

descriptions.hgss: The user compels the foe to keep using only the move it last used for three to seven turns.

effect.full: The next 4–8 times (selected at random) the target attempts to move, it is forced to repeat its last used move. If the selected move allows the trainer to select a target, an opponent will be selected at random each turn. If the target is prevented from using the selected move by some other effect, Struggle will be used instead. This effect ends if the selected move runs out of PP. If the target hasn’t used a move since entering the field, if it tried to use a move this turn and failed, if it does not know the selected move, or if the selected move has 0 PP remaining, this move will fail. If the target’s last used move was Encore, Mimic, Mirror Move, Sketch, Struggle, or Transform, this move will fail.

descriptions.zh: 通过旋转来攻击对手。 可以摆脱绑紧、紧束、寄生种子 等招式。还能提高自己的速度。

effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage.

descriptions.zh: 用钢铁之爪 劈开对手进行攻击。 有时会提高自己的攻击。
descriptions.ja: 鋼鉄の ツメで 相手を 切り裂いて 攻撃する。 自分の 攻撃が あがることが ある。
descriptions.hgss: The foe is raked with steel claws. It may also raise the user’s Attack stat.

effect.short: Has a chance to raise the user’s Attack by one stage.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to raise the user’s Attack one stage.

descriptions.zh: 会在对手之后进行攻击。 但是自己的攻击必定会命中。
descriptions.ja: 相手より あとに 攻撃する。 そのかわり 自分の 攻撃は 必ず 命中する。

effect.short: Never misses.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.
