descriptions.hgss: A unique attack that varies in type and intensity depending on the Pokémon using it.

effect.short: Power and type depend upon user’s IVs. Power can range from 30 to 70.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Power and type are determined by the user’s IVs. Power is given by `x * 40 / 63 + 30`. `x` is obtained by arranging bit 1 from the IV for each of Special Defense, Special Attack, Speed, Defense, Attack, and HP in that order. (Bit 1 is 1 if the IV is of the form `4n + 2` or `4n + 3`. `x` is then 64 * Special Defense IV bit 1, plus 32 * Special Attack IV bit 1, etc.) Power is always between 30 and 70, inclusive. Average power is 49.5. Type is given by `y * 15 / 63`, where `y` is similar to `x` above, except constructed from bit 0. (Bit 0 is 1 if the IV is odd.) The result is looked up in the following table. Value | Type ----: | -------- 0 | Fighting 1 | Flying 2 | Poison 3 | Ground 4 | Rock 5 | Bug 6 | Ghost 7 | Steel 8 | Fire 9 | Water 10 | Grass 11 | Electric 12 | Psychic 13 | Ice 14 | Dragon 15 | Dark This move thus cannot be Normal. Most other types have an equal 1/16 chance to be selected, given random IVs. However, due to the flooring used here, Bug, Fighting, and Grass appear 5/64 of the time, and Dark only 1/64 of the time.

descriptions.zh: 用两手呈十字 劈打对手进行攻击。 容易击中要害。
descriptions.ja: 両手チョップを 相手に たたきつけて 攻撃する。 急所に 当たりやすい。
descriptions.hgss: The user delivers a double chop with its forearms crossed. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

effect.short: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

descriptions.zh: 兴起龙卷风， 将对手卷入进行攻击。 有时会使对手畏缩。
descriptions.ja: 竜巻を おこして 相手を まきこみ 攻撃する。 相手を ひるませることが ある。
descriptions.hgss: The user whips up a vicious tornado to tear at the foe. It may also make the foe flinch.

effect.short: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make each target flinch. If the target is under the effect of Bounce, Fly, or Sky Drop, this move will hit with double power.

descriptions.zh: 在５回合内一直降雨， 从而提高水属性的招式威力。 火属性的招式威力则降低。
descriptions.ja: ５ターンの 間 雨を 降らせて みずタイプの 威力を あげる。 ほのおタイプの 威力は さがる。
descriptions.hgss: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water- type moves.

effect.short: Changes the weather to rain for five turns.
effect.full: Changes the weather to rain for five turns, during which Water moves inflict 50% extra damage, and Fire moves inflict half damage. If the user is holding Damp Rock, this effect lasts for eight turns. Thunder has 100% accuracy. If the target has used Detect or Protect, Thunder has a (100 - accuracy)% chance to break through the protection. Solar Beam has half power. Moonlight, Morning Sun, and Synthesis heal only 1/4 of the user’s max HP. Pokémon with Swift Swim have doubled original Speed. Pokémon with Forecast become Water. Pokémon with Dry Skin heal 1/8 max HP, Pokémon with Hydration are cured of major status effects, and Pokémon with Rain Dish heal 1/16 max HP at the end of each turn.

descriptions.zh: 在５回合内让日照变得强烈， 从而提高火属性的招式威力。 水属性的招式威力则降低。
descriptions.ja: ５ターンの 間 日差しを 強くして ほのおタイプの 威力を あげる。 みずタイプの 威力は さがる。
descriptions.hgss: The user intensifies the sun for five turns, powering up Fire-type moves.

effect.short: Changes the weather to sunny for five turns.
effect.full: Changes the weather to sunshine for five turns, during which Fire moves inflict 50% extra damage, and Water moves inflict half damage. If the user is holding Heat Rock, this effect lasts for eight turns. Pokémon cannot become frozen. Thunder has 50% accuracy. Solar Beam skips its charge turn. Moonlight, Morning Sun, and Synthesis heal 2/3 of the user’s max HP. Pokémon with Chlorophyll have doubled original Speed. Pokémon with Forecast become Fire. Pokémon with Leaf Guard are not affected by major status effects. Pokémon with Flower Gift change form; every Pokémon on their side of the field have their original Attack and Special Attack increased by 50%. Pokémon with Dry Skin lose 1/8 max HP at the end of each turn. Pokémon with Solar Power have their original Special Attack raised by 50% but lose 1/8 their max HP at the end of each turn.

descriptions.zh: 用利牙咬碎对手进行攻击。 有时会降低对手的防御。
descriptions.ja: 鋭い 歯で 相手を かみくだいて 攻撃する。 相手の 防御を さげることが ある。
descriptions.hgss: The user crunches up the foe with sharp fangs. It may also lower the target’s Defense stat.

effect.short: Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage.

descriptions.zh: 从对手那里受到 特殊攻击的伤害将以 ２倍返还给同一个对手。
descriptions.ja: 相手から 受けた 特殊攻撃の ダメージを ２倍に して その相手に 返す。
descriptions.hgss: A retaliation move that counters any special attack, inflicting double the damage taken.

effect.short: Inflicts twice the damage the user received from the last special hit it took.
effect.full: Targets the last opposing Pokémon to hit the user with a special move this turn. Inflicts twice the damage that move did to the user. If there is no eligible target, this move will fail. Type immunity applies, but other type effects are ignored. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move, nor selected by Assist or Metronome.

descriptions.zh: 向自己施以自我暗示， 将能力变化的状态 变得和对手一样。
descriptions.ja: 自分に 暗示を かけることで 能力変化の 状態を 相手と 同じにする。
descriptions.hgss: The user hypnotizes itself into copying any stat change made by the foe.

effect.short: Discards the user’s stat changes and copies the target’s.
effect.full: Discards the user’s stat changes and copies the target’s. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move.

descriptions.zh: 以迅雷不及掩耳之势 猛撞向对手进行攻击。 必定能够先制攻击。
descriptions.ja: 目にも 留まらぬ ものすごい 速さで 相手に 突進して 攻撃する。 必ず 先制攻撃 できる。
descriptions.hgss: The user charges the foe at blinding speed. This attack always goes before any other move.

effect.short: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage.

descriptions.zh: 用原始之力进行攻击。 有时会提高 自己所有的能力。
descriptions.ja: 原始の 力で 攻撃する。 自分の すべての 能力が あがることが ある。
descriptions.hgss: The user attacks with a prehistoric power. It may also raise all the user’s stats at once.

effect.short: Has a chance to raise all of the user’s stats by one stage.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to raise all of the user’s stats one stage.

descriptions.zh: 投掷一团黑影进行攻击。 有时会降低对手的特防。
descriptions.ja: 黒い影の 塊を 投げつけて 攻撃する。 相手の 特防を さげることが ある。
descriptions.hgss: The user hurls a shadowy blob at the foe. It may also lower the foe’s Sp. Def stat.

effect.short: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.

descriptions.zh: 在使用招式２回合后， 向对手发送一团念力进行攻击。
descriptions.ja: 技を 使った ２ターン後に 相手に 念力の 塊を 送って 攻撃する。
descriptions.hgss: Two turns after this move is used, the foe is attacked with a hunk of psychic energy.

effect.short: Hits the target two turns later.
effect.full: Inflicts typeless regular damage at the end of the third turn, starting with this one. This move cannot score a critical hit. If the target switches out, its replacement will be hit instead. Damage is calculated at the time this move is used; stat changes and switching out during the delay won’t change the damage inflicted. No move with this effect can be used against the same target again until after the end of the third turn. This effect breaks through Wonder Guard. If the target is protected by Protect or Detect on the turn this move is used, this move will fail. However, the damage on the third turn will break through protection. The damage is applied at the end of the turn, so it ignores Endure and Focus Sash. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move.

descriptions.zh: 用拳头进行攻击。 有时会降低对手的防御。
descriptions.ja: パンチで 攻撃する。相手の 防御を さげる ことが ある。
descriptions.hgss: The user hits with a punch that may lower the target’s Defense. It can also smash cracked boulders.

effect.short: Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage.

descriptions.zh: 将对手困在激烈的 水流旋涡中， 在４～５回合内进行攻击。
descriptions.ja: 激しく 渦をまく 水の中に ４ー５ターンの 間 相手を 閉じこめて 攻撃する。
descriptions.hgss: Traps the foe inside a whirlpool that lasts for two to five turns. The user can pass through whirlpools.

effect.short: Prevents the target from leaving battle and inflicts 1/16 its max HP in damage for 2-5 turns.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. For the next 2–5 turns, the target cannot leave the field and is damaged for 1/16 its max HP at the end of each turn. The user continues to use other moves during this time. If the user leaves the field, this effect ends. Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use. If the target is in the first turn of Dive, this move will hit with double power.

descriptions.zh: 我方全员进行攻击。 同行的宝可梦越多， 招式的攻击次数越多。
descriptions.ja: 味方 全員で 攻撃する。 仲間の ポケモンが 多いほど 技の 攻撃回数が 増える。
descriptions.hgss: The user gets all the party Pokémon to attack the foe. The more party Pokémon, the more damage.

effect.short: Hits once for every conscious Pokémon the trainer has.
effect.full: Inflicts typeless regular damage. Every Pokémon in the user’s party, excepting those that have fainted or have a major status effect, attacks the target. Calculated stats are ignored; the base stats for the target and assorted attackers are used instead. The random factor in the damage formula is not used. Dark Pokémon still get STAB. This effect breaks through Wonder Guard.

descriptions.zh: 进行先制攻击，使对手畏缩。 要在出场后立刻使出才能成功。
descriptions.ja: 先制攻撃で 相手を ひるませる。 戦闘に でたら すぐに ださないと 成功しない。
descriptions.hgss: An attack that hits first and makes the target flinch. It only works the first turn the user is in battle.

effect.short: Can only be used as the first move after the user enters battle. Causes the target to flinch.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Causes the target to flinch. Can only be used on the user’s first turn after entering the field.

descriptions.zh: 在３回合内 用骚乱攻击对手。 在此期间谁都不能入眠。
descriptions.ja: ３ターンの 間 騒いで 相手を 攻撃する。 そのあいだは だれも 眠れなくなる。
descriptions.hgss: The user attacks in an uproar for two to five turns. Over that time, no one can fall asleep.

effect.short: Forced to use this move for several turns. Pokémon cannot fall asleep in that time.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. User is forced to use this move for 2–5 turns, selected at random. All Pokémon on the field wake up, and none can fall to sleep until the lock-in ends. Pokémon cannot use Rest during this effect. This move cannot be selected by Sleep Talk.

descriptions.zh: 积蓄力量， 提高自己的防御和特防。 最多积蓄３次。
descriptions.ja: 力を 蓄えて 自分の 防御と 特防を あげる。 最大 ３回まで 蓄えられる。
descriptions.hgss: The user charges up power, and raises both its Defense and Sp. Def. The move can be used three times.

effect.short: Stores energy up to three times for use with Spit Up and Swallow.
effect.full: Raises the user’s Defense and Special Defense by one stage each. Stores energy for use with Spit Up and Swallow. Up to three levels of energy can be stored, and all are lost if the user leaves the field. Energy is still stored even if the stat boosts cannot be applied. If the user uses Baton Pass, the stat boosts are passed as normal, but the stored energy is not.

descriptions.zh: 将积蓄的力量 撞向对手进行攻击。 积蓄得越多，威力越大。
descriptions.ja: 蓄えた 力を 相手に ぶつけて 攻撃する。 蓄えているほど 威力が あがる。
descriptions.hgss: The power stored using the move Stockpile is released at once in an attack.

effect.short: Power is 100 times the amount of energy Stockpiled.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Power is equal to 100 times the amount of energy stored by Stockpile. Ignores the random factor in the damage formula. Stored energy is consumed, and the user’s Defense and Special Defense are reset to what they would be if Stockpile had not been used. If the user has no energy stored, this move will fail. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move.

descriptions.zh: 将积蓄的力量吞下， 从而回复自己的ＨＰ。 积蓄得越多，回复越大。
descriptions.ja: 蓄えた 力を のみこんで 自分の ＨＰを 回復する。 蓄えているほど 回復する。
descriptions.hgss: The power stored using the move Stockpile is absorbed by the user to heal its HP.

effect.short: Recovers 1/4 HP after one Stockpile, 1/2 HP after two Stockpiles, or full HP after three Stockpiles.
effect.full: Heals the user depending on the amount of energy stored by Stockpile: 1/4 its max HP after one use, 1/2 its max HP after two uses, or fully after three uses. Stored energy is consumed, and the user’s Defense and Special Defense are reset to what they would be if Stockpile had not been used. If the user has no energy stored, this move will fail.

descriptions.zh: 将炎热的气息 吹向对手进行攻击。 有时会让对手陷入灼伤状态。
descriptions.ja: 熱い 息を 相手に 吹きつけて 攻撃する。 やけど状態に することが ある。
descriptions.hgss: The user exhales a heated breath on the foe to attack. It may also leave the target with a burn.

effect.short: Has a chance to burn the target.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target.

descriptions.zh: 在５回合内一直降冰雹， 除冰属性的宝可梦以外， 给予全体宝可梦伤害。
descriptions.ja: ５ターンの 間 あられを 降らして こおりタイプで ない ポケモン 全員に ダメージを 与える。
descriptions.hgss: The user summons a hailstorm lasting five turns. It damages all Pokémon except the Ice type.

effect.short: Changes the weather to a hailstorm for five turns.
effect.full: Changes the weather to hail for five turns, during which non-Ice Pokémon are damaged for 1/16 their max HP at the end of every turn. If the user is holding Icy Rock, this effect lasts for eight turns. Blizzard has 100% accuracy. If the target has used Detect or Protect, Blizzard has a (100 - accuracy)% chance to break through the protection. Moonlight, Morning Sun, and Synthesis heal only 1/4 of the user’s max HP. Pokémon with Snow Cloak are exempt from this effect’s damage.

descriptions.zh: 向对手无理取闹， 令其不能连续２次 使出相同招式。
descriptions.ja: 相手に いちゃもんを つけて 同じ 技を ２回連続で だせなくする。
descriptions.hgss: The user torments and enrages the foe, making it incapable of using the same move twice in a row.

effect.short: Prevents the target from using the same move twice in a row.
effect.full: Prevents the target from attempting to use the same move twice in a row. When the target leaves the field, this effect ends. If the target is forced to attempt a repeated move due to Choice Band, Choice Scarf, Choice Specs, Disable, Encore, Taunt, only having PP remaining for one move, or any other effect, the target will use Struggle instead. The target is then free to use the forced move next turn, as it didn’t use that move this turn.

descriptions.zh: 吹捧对手，使其混乱。 同时还会提高对手的特攻。
descriptions.ja: 相手を おだてて 混乱させる。 同時に 相手の 特攻も あげてしまう。
descriptions.hgss: Flattery is used to confuse the foe. However, it also raises the target’s Sp. Atk stat.

effect.short: Raises the target’s Special Attack by one stage and confuses the target.
effect.full: Raises the target’s Special Attack by one stage, then confuses it.

descriptions.zh: 放出怪异的火焰， 从而让对手陷入灼伤状态。
descriptions.ja: 不気味で 怪しい 炎を 放って 相手を やけどの 状態に する。
descriptions.hgss: The user shoots a sinister, bluish white flame at the foe to inflict a burn.

effect.short: Burns the target.
effect.full: Burns the target.

descriptions.zh: 虽然会使自己陷入濒死， 但是能够大幅降低 对手的攻击和特攻。
descriptions.ja: 自分は ひんしに なるが そのかわりに 相手の 攻撃と 特攻を がくっと さげる。
descriptions.hgss: The user faints upon using this move. In return, it sharply lowers the target’s Attack and Sp. Atk.

effect.short: Lowers the target’s Attack and Special Attack by two stages. User faints.
effect.full: Lowers the target’s Attack and Special Attack by two stages. User faints.

descriptions.zh: 当自己处于中毒、麻痹、灼伤状态时， 向对手使出此招式的话， 威力会变成２倍。
descriptions.ja: 自分が 毒 まひ やけど 状態のとき 相手に くりだすと 技の 威力が ２倍に なる。
descriptions.hgss: An attack move that doubles its power if the user is poisoned, paralyzed, or has a burn.

effect.short: Power doubles if user is burned, paralyzed, or poisoned.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. If the user is burned, paralyzed, or poisoned, this move has double power.

descriptions.zh: 集中精神出拳。 在招式使出前 若受到攻击则会失败。
descriptions.ja: 精神を 高めて パンチを くりだす。 技を だすまでに 攻撃を 受けると 失敗する。
descriptions.hgss: The user focuses its mind before launching a punch. It will fail if the user is hit before it is used.

effect.short: If the user takes damage before attacking, the attack is canceled.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. If the user takes damage this turn before hitting, this move will fail. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move, nor selected by Assist, Metronome, or Sleep Talk.

descriptions.zh: 无法使用这个招式。 虽然忘记之后就再也想不起来了， 但还是建议忘记这个招式。
descriptions.ja: この技は 使えません 思い出すことが できなくなりますが 技を 忘れることを おすすめします
descriptions.hgss: This attack inflicts double damage on a paralyzed foe. It also cures the foe’s paralysis, however.

effect.short: If the target is paralyzed, inflicts double damage and cures the paralysis.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. If the target is paralyzed, this move has double power, and the target is cured of its paralysis.

descriptions.zh: 引起对手的注意， 将对手的攻击 全部转移到自己身上。
descriptions.ja: 自分に 注目させて 相手からの 攻撃を すべて 自分に むけさせる。
descriptions.hgss: The user draws attention to itself, making all foes take aim only at the user.

effect.short: Redirects the target’s single-target effects to the user for this turn.
effect.full: Until the end of this turn, any moves that opposing Pokémon target solely at the user’s ally will instead target the user. If both Pokémon on the same side of the field use this move on the same turn, the Pokémon that uses it last will become the target. This effect takes priority over Lightning Rod and Storm Drain. If the user’s ally switches out, opposing Pokémon may still hit it with Pursuit. This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome.

descriptions.zh: 用自然之力进行攻击。 根据所使用场所的不同， 使出的招式也会有所变化。
descriptions.ja: 自然の 力で 攻撃する。 使う 場所で でてくる 技が 変化する。
descriptions.hgss: An attack that makes use of nature’s power. Its effects vary depending on the user’s environment.

effect.short: Uses a move which depends upon the terrain.
effect.full: Uses another move chosen according to the terrain. Terrain | Selected move ------------------------- | ------------------ Building | Tri Attack Cave | Rock Slide Deep water | Hydro Pump Desert | Earthquake Grass | Seed Bomb Mountain | Rock Slide Road | Earthquake Shallow water | Hydro Pump Snow | Blizzard Tall grass | Seed Bomb Electric Terrain | Thunderbolt Grassy Terrain | Energy Ball Misty Terrain | Moonblast In Pokémon Battle Revolution: Terrain | Selected move -------------- | ------------------ Courtyard | Tri Attack Crystal | Rock Slide Gateway | Hydro Pump Magma | Rock Slide Main Street | Tri Attack Neon | Tri Attack Stargazer | Rock Slide Sunny Park | Seed Bomb Sunset | Earthquake Waterfall | Seed Bomb This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move.

descriptions.zh: 提高下一回合使出的 电属性的招式威力。 自己的特防也会提高。
descriptions.ja: 次の ターンに だす でんきタイプの 技の 威力を あげる。 自分の 特防も あがる。
descriptions.hgss: The user boosts the power of the Electric move it uses next. It also raises the user’s Sp. Def stat.

effect.short: Raises the user’s Special Defense by one stage. User’s Electric moves have doubled power next turn.
effect.full: Raises the user’s Special Defense by one stage. If the user uses an Electric move next turn, its power will be doubled.

descriptions.zh: 使对手愤怒。 在３回合内让对手 只能使出给予伤害的招式。
descriptions.ja: 相手を 怒らせる。 ３ターンの 間 相手は ダメージを 与える 技しか だせなくなる。
descriptions.hgss: The foe is taunted into a rage that allows it to use only attack moves for two to four turns.

effect.short: For the next few turns, the target can only use damaging moves.
effect.full: Target is forced to only use damaging moves for the next 3–5 turns, selected at random. Moves that select other moves not known in advance do not count as damaging. Assist, Copycat, Me First, Metronome, Mirror Move, and Sleep Talk do not directly inflict damage and thus may not be used. Bide, Counter, Endeavor, Metal Burst, and Mirror Coat are allowed.

descriptions.zh: 帮助伙伴。 被帮助的宝可梦， 其招式威力变得比平时大。
descriptions.ja: 仲間を 助ける。 てだすけ された ポケモンの 技の 威力は いつもより 大きくなる。
descriptions.hgss: A move that boosts the power of the ally’s attack in a Double Battle.

effect.short: Ally’s next move inflicts half more damage.
effect.full: Boosts the power of the target’s moves by 50% until the end of this turn. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move, nor selected by Assist or Metronome.

descriptions.zh: 抓住对手的空隙， 交换自己和对手的持有物。
descriptions.ja: 相手の すきを ついて 自分と 相手の 持ち物を 交換する。
descriptions.hgss: The user catches the foe off guard and swaps the foe’s held item with its own.

effect.short: User and target swap items.
effect.full: User and target permanently swap held items. Works even if one of the Pokémon isn’t holding anything. If either Pokémon is holding mail, this move will fail. If either Pokémon has Multitype or Sticky Hold, this move will fail. If this move results in a Pokémon obtaining Choice Band, Choice Scarf, or Choice Specs, and that Pokémon was the latter of the pair to move this turn, then the move it used this turn becomes its chosen forced move. This applies even if both Pokémon had a choice item before this move was used. If the first of the two Pokémon gains a choice item, it may select whatever choice move it wishes next turn. Neither the user nor the target can recover its item with Recycle. This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome.

descriptions.zh: 扮演对手， 让自己的特性 变得和对手相同。
descriptions.ja: 相手に なりきって 自分も 相手と 同じ 特性に 変化する。
descriptions.hgss: The user mimics the foe completely, copying the foe’s natural ability.

effect.short: Copies the target’s ability.
effect.full: User’s ability is replaced with the target’s until the user leaves the field. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. If the target has Flower Gift, Forecast, Illusion, Imposter, Multitype, Stance Change, Trace, Wonder Guard, or Zen Mode, this move will fail. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move.

descriptions.zh: 在下一回合回复自己或是 替换出场的宝可梦最大ＨＰ的一半。
descriptions.ja: 次の ターンに 自分 もしくは 入れ替わった ポケモンの ＨＰを 最大ＨＰの 半分 回復する。
descriptions.hgss: A self-healing move. The user restores its own HP by up to half of its maximum HP in the next turn.

effect.short: User will recover half its max HP at the end of the next turn.
effect.full: At the end of the next turn, user will be healed for half its max HP. If the user is switched out, its replacement will be healed instead for half of the user’s max HP. If the user faints or is forcefully switched by Roar or Whirlwind, this effect will not activate.

descriptions.zh: 无法使用这个招式。 虽然忘记之后就再也想不起来了， 但还是建议忘记这个招式。
descriptions.ja: この技は 使えません 思い出すことが できなくなりますが 技を 忘れることを おすすめします
descriptions.hgss: The user hurriedly and randomly uses a move among those known by other Pokémon in the party.

effect.short: Randomly selects and uses one of the trainer’s other Pokémon’s moves.
effect.full: Uses a move from another Pokémon in the user’s party, both selected at random. Moves from fainted Pokémon can be used. If there are no eligible Pokémon or moves, this move will fail. This move will not select Assist, Chatter, Circle Throw, Copycat, Counter, Covet, Destiny Bond, Detect, Dig, Dive, Dragon Tail, Endure, Feint, Fly Focus Punch, Follow Me, Helping Hand, Me First, Metronome, Mimic, Mirror Coat, Mirror Move, Phantom Force Protect, Quick Guard, Roar Shadow Force, Sketch, Sleep Talk, Snatch, Struggle, Switcheroo, Thief, Trick, Whirlwind, or Wide Guard. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move, nor selected by Metronome or Sleep Talk.

descriptions.zh: 在大地上扎根， 每回合回复自己的ＨＰ。 因为扎根了，所以不能替换宝可梦。
descriptions.ja: 大地に 根を 張り 毎ターン 自分の ＨＰを 回復する。 根を 張っているので 入れ替えられない。
descriptions.hgss: The user lays roots that restore HP on every turn. Because it is rooted, it can’t switch out.

effect.short: Prevents the user from leaving battle. User regains 1/16 of its max HP every turn.
effect.full: Prevents the user from switching out. User regains 1/16 of its max HP at the end of every turn. If the user was immune to Ground attacks, it will now take normal damage from them. Roar and Whirlwind will not affect the user. The user cannot use Magnet Rise. The user may still use U-turn to leave the field. This effect can be passed with Baton Pass.

descriptions.zh: 发挥惊人的力量攻击对手。 自己的攻击和防御会降低。
descriptions.ja: すごい 力を 発揮して 相手を 攻撃する。自分の 攻撃と 防御が さがる。
descriptions.hgss: The user attacks the foe with great power. However, it also lowers the user’s Attack and Defense.

effect.short: Lowers the user’s Attack and Defense by one stage after inflicting damage.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user’s Attack and Defense by one stage each.

descriptions.zh: 当对手使出会变成异常状态的 招式或寄生种子等时， 会将对手的招式反射回去。
descriptions.ja: 状態異常に なる 技や やどりぎのタネ などを だされたとき 相手に 跳ね返す。
descriptions.hgss: A barrier reflects back to the foe moves like Leech Seed and moves that damage status.

effect.short: Reflects back the first effect move used on the user this turn.
effect.full: The first non-damaging move targeting the user this turn that inflicts major status effects, stat changes, or trapping effects will be reflected at its user. Defog, Memento, and Teeter Dance are not reflected. Attract, Flatter, Gastro Acid, Leech Seed, Swagger, Worry Seed, and Yawn are reflected. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move.

descriptions.zh: 使战斗中已经消耗掉的 自己的持有物再生， 并可以再次使用。
descriptions.ja: 戦闘中に 使って なくなった 自分の 持ち物を 再生させて 使えるように する。
descriptions.hgss: The user recycles a held item that has been used in battle so it can be used again.

effect.short: User recovers the item it last used up.
effect.full: User recovers the last item consumed by the user or a Pokémon in its position on the field. The item must be used again before it can be recovered by this move again. If the user is holding an item, this move fails. Items taken or given away by Covet, Knock Off, Switcheroo, Thief, or Trick may not be recovered.

descriptions.zh: 如果受到对手的招式攻击， 就能给予对手２倍的伤害。
descriptions.ja: 相手から 技を 受けていると その相手に 対して 与える ダメージが ２倍に なる。
descriptions.hgss: An attack move that inflicts double the damage if the user has been hurt by the foe in the same turn.

effect.short: Inflicts double damage if the user takes damage before attacking this turn.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. If the target damaged the user this turn and was the last to do so, this move has double power. Pain Split does not count as damaging the user.

descriptions.zh: 将手刀猛烈地挥下攻击对手。 还可以破坏光墙和反射壁等。
descriptions.ja: 手刀を 勢いよく 振りおろして 相手を 攻撃する。 ひかりのかべや リフレクター なども 破壊できる。
descriptions.hgss: The user attacks with tough fists, etc. It can also break any barrier such as Light Screen and Reflect.

effect.short: Destroys Reflect and Light Screen.
effect.full: Destroys any Light Screen or Reflect on the target’s side of the field, then inflicts regular damage.

descriptions.zh: 打个大哈欠引起睡意。 在下一回合让对手陷入睡眠状态。
descriptions.ja: 大きな あくびで 眠気を 誘う。 次の ターンに 相手を 眠り状態に する。
descriptions.hgss: The user lets loose a huge yawn that lulls the foe into falling asleep on the next turn.

effect.short: Target sleeps at the end of the next turn.
effect.full: Puts the target to sleep at the end of the next turn. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. If the target leaves the field, this effect is canceled. If the target has a status effect when this move is used, this move will fail. If the target is protected by Safeguard when this move is used, this move will fail. Insomnia and Vital Spirit prevent the sleep if the target has either at the end of the next turn, but will not cause this move to fail on use.

descriptions.zh: 拍落对手的持有物， 直到战斗结束都不能使用。 对手携带道具时会增加伤害。
descriptions.ja: 相手の 持ち物を はたき 落として 戦闘が 終わるまで 使えなくする。 物を持つ 相手には ダメージが増す。
descriptions.hgss: The user slaps down the foe’s held item, preventing the item from being used during the battle.

effect.short: Target drops its held item.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Target loses its held item. Neither the user nor the target can recover its item with Recycle. If the target has Multitype or Sticky Hold, it will take damage but not lose its item.

descriptions.zh: 给予伤害， 使对手的ＨＰ变得 和自己的ＨＰ一样。
descriptions.ja: 相手の ＨＰが 自分の ＨＰと 同じくらいに なるように ダメージを 与える。
descriptions.hgss: An attack move that cuts down the foe’s HP to equal the user’s HP.

effect.short: Lowers the target’s HP to equal the user’s.
effect.full: Inflicts exactly enough damage to lower the target’s HP to equal the user’s. If the target’s HP is not higher than the user’s, this move has no effect. Type immunity applies, but other type effects are ignored. This effect counts as damage for moves that respond to damage.

descriptions.zh: 爆发怒火攻击对手。 自己的ＨＰ越少， 招式的威力越小。
descriptions.ja: 怒りを 爆発させて 相手を 攻撃する。 自分の ＨＰが 少ないほど 技の 威力は さがる。
descriptions.hgss: The user attacks in an explosive fury. The lower the user’s HP, the less powerful this attack becomes.

effect.short: Inflicts more damage when the user has more HP remaining, with a maximum of 150 power.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Power increases with the user’s remaining HP and is given by `150 * HP / max HP`, to a maximum of 150 when the user has full HP.

descriptions.zh: 利用超能力互换 自己和对手的特性。
descriptions.ja: 超能力で 自分の 特性と 相手の 特性を 入れ替える。
descriptions.hgss: The user employs its psychic power to exchange abilities with the foe.

effect.short: User and target swap abilities.
effect.full: User and target switch abilities. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. If either Pokémon has Multitype or Wonder Guard, this move will fail.

descriptions.zh: 如果对手有和自己相同的招式， 那么只有对手无法使用该招式。
descriptions.ja: 相手が 自分と 同じ 技を おぼえていたら 相手だけ その技を 使えなくする。
descriptions.hgss: If the foe knows any move also known by the user, the foe is prevented from using it.

effect.short: Prevents the target from using any moves that the user also knows.
effect.full: Prevents any Pokémon on the opposing side of the field from using any move the user knows until the user leaves the field. This effect is live; if the user obtains new moves while on the field, these moves become restricted. If no opposing Pokémon knows any of the user’s moves when this move is used, this move will fail.

descriptions.zh: 无法使用这个招式。 虽然忘记之后就再也想不起来了， 但还是建议忘记这个招式。
descriptions.ja: この技は 使えません 思い出すことが できなくなりますが 技を 忘れることを おすすめします
descriptions.hgss: The user rests to cure itself of a poisoning, burn, or paralysis.

effect.short: Cleanses the user of a burn, paralysis, or poison.
effect.full: Removes a burn, paralysis, or poison from the user.

descriptions.zh: 因对手的招式而陷入濒死时 给对手施加怨念， 让该招式的ＰＰ变成０。
descriptions.ja: 相手の 技で ひんしに されたとき おんねんを かけて その技の ＰＰを ０に する。
descriptions.hgss: If the user faints, the user’s grudge fully depletes the PP of the foe’s move that knocked it out.

effect.short: If the user faints this turn, the PP of the move that fainted it drops to 0.
effect.full: If the user faints before it next acts, the move that fainted it will have its PP dropped to 0. End-of-turn damage does not trigger this effect.

descriptions.zh: 无法使用这个招式。 虽然忘记之后就再也想不起来了， 但还是建议忘记这个招式。
descriptions.ja: この技は 使えません 思い出すことが できなくなりますが 技を 忘れることを おすすめします
descriptions.hgss: The user steals the effects of any healing or stat- changing move the foe attempts to use.

effect.short: Steals the target’s move, if it’s self-targeted.
effect.full: The next time a Pokémon uses a beneficial move on itself or itself and its ally this turn, the user of this move will steal the move and use it itself. Moves which may be stolen by this move are identified by the "snatchable" flag. If two Pokémon use this move on the same turn, the faster Pokémon will steal the first beneficial move, and the slower Pokémon will then steal it again—thus, only the slowest Pokémon using this move ultimately gains a stolen move’s effect. If the user steals Psych Up, it will target the Pokémon that used Psych Up. If the user was the original target of Psych Up, and the Pokémon that originally used it’s affected by Pressure, it will only lose 1 PP. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move, nor selected by Assist or Metronome.

descriptions.zh: 无法使用这个招式。 虽然忘记之后就再也想不起来了， 但还是建议忘记这个招式。
descriptions.ja: この技は 使えません 思い出すことが できなくなりますが 技を 忘れることを おすすめします
descriptions.hgss: The user attacks with a secret power. Its added effects vary depending on the user’s environment.

effect.short: Has a chance to inflict a status effect which depends upon the terrain.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to inflict an effect chosen according to the terrain. Terrain | Effect -------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- Building | Paralyzes target Cave | Makes target flinch Deep water | Lowers target’s Attack by one stage Desert | Lowers target’s accuracy by one stage Grass | Puts target to sleep Mountain | Makes target flinch Road | Lowers target’s accuracy by one stage Shallow water | Lowers target’s Attack by one stage Snow | Freezes target Tall grass | Puts target to sleep In Pokémon Battle Revolution: Terrain | Effect -------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- Courtyard | Paralyzes target Crystal | Makes target flinch Gateway | Lowers target’s Attack by one stage Magma | Makes target flinch Main Street | Paralyzes target Neon | Paralyzes target Stargazer | Makes target flinch Sunny Park | Puts target to sleep Sunset | Lowers target’s accuracy by one stage Waterfall | Puts target to sleep

descriptions.zh: 第１回合潜入， 第２回合浮上来进行攻击。
descriptions.ja: １ターン目で 潜り ２ターン目に 浮きあがって 攻撃する。
descriptions.hgss: A two-turn attack. The user dives underwater on the first turn, then hits on the next turn.

effect.short: User dives underwater, dodging all attacks, and hits next turn.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. User dives underwater for one turn, becoming immune to attack, and hits on the second turn. During the immune turn, Surf, and Whirlpool still hit the user normally, and their power is doubled if appropriate.
