descriptions.hgss: The foe is slammed with an enormous tree. The user can’t move on the next turn.

effect.short: User foregoes its next turn to recharge.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. User loses its next turn to "recharge", and cannot attack or switch out during that turn.

descriptions.zh: 使出全身力气绷紧肌肉， 从而提高自己的攻击和防御。
descriptions.ja: 体に 力を こめて 筋肉を ぶあつく することで 自分の 攻撃と 防御を あげる。
descriptions.hgss: The user tenses its muscles to bulk up its body, boosting both its Attack and Defense stats.

effect.short: Raises the user’s Attack and Defense by one stage.
effect.full: Raises the user’s Attack and Defense by one stage each.

descriptions.zh: 弹跳到高高的空中， 第２回合攻击对手。 有时会让对手陷入麻痹状态。
descriptions.ja: 空高く 飛び跳ねて ２ターン目に 相手を 攻撃する。 まひ状態に することが ある。
descriptions.hgss: The user bounces up high, then drops on the foe on the second turn. It may also paralyze the foe.

effect.short: User bounces high into the air, dodging all attacks, and hits next turn.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. User bounces high into the air for one turn, becoming immune to attack, and hits on the second turn. Has a chance to paralyze the target. During the immune turn, Gust, Hurricane, Sky Uppercut, Smack Down, Thunder, and Twister still hit the user normally. Gust and Twister also have double power against the user. The damage from Hail and Sandstorm still applies during the immune turn. The user may be hit during its immune turn if under the effect of Lock-On, Mind Reader, or No Guard. This move cannot be used while Gravity is in effect. This move cannot be selected by Sleep Talk.

descriptions.zh: 向对手投掷 泥块进行攻击。 同时降低对手的速度。
descriptions.ja: 泥の 塊を 相手に 投げつけて 攻撃する。 同時に 相手の 素早さを さげる。
descriptions.hgss: The user attacks by hurling a blob of mud at the foe. It also reduces the target’s Speed.

effect.short: Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.

descriptions.zh: 用尾巴拍打。 有时会让对手陷入中毒状态， 也容易击中要害。
descriptions.ja: しっぽで たたく。 毒状態に することが あり 急所にも 当たりやすい。
descriptions.hgss: An attack with a high critical-hit ratio. This tail attack may also poison the foe.

effect.short: Has an increased chance for a critical hit and a chance to poison the target.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move. Has a chance to poison the target.

descriptions.zh: 一边可爱地撒娇， 一边靠近对手进行攻击， 还能夺取对手携带的道具。
descriptions.ja: かわいく あまえながら 相手に ちかづき 持っている 道具を うばう。
descriptions.hgss: The user endearingly approaches the foe, then steals the item the foe is holding.

effect.short: Takes the target’s item.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. If the target is holding an item and the user is not, the user will permanently take the item. Damage is still inflicted if an item cannot be taken. Pokémon with Sticky Hold or Multitype are immune to the item theft effect. The target cannot recover its item with Recycle. This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome.

descriptions.zh: 让电流覆盖全身猛撞向对手。 自己也会受到不小的伤害。 有时会让对手陷入麻痹状态。
descriptions.ja: 電気を まとって 突進する。 自分も かなり ダメージを 受ける。 まひ状態に することが ある。
descriptions.hgss: The user electrifies itself, then charges at the foe. It causes considerable damage to the user as well.

effect.short: User takes 1/3 the damage inflicted in recoil. Has a chance to paralyze the target.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. User takes 1/3 the damage it inflicts in recoil. Has a chance to paralyze the target.

descriptions.zh: 散落可以追踪 对手的神奇叶片。 攻击必定会命中。
descriptions.ja: 相手を 追跡する 不思議な はっぱを まきちらす。 攻撃は 必ず 命中する。
descriptions.hgss: The user scatters curious leaves that chase the foe. This attack will not miss.

effect.short: Never misses.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

descriptions.zh: 无法使用这个招式。 虽然忘记之后就再也想不起来了， 但还是建议忘记这个招式。
descriptions.ja: この技は 使えません 思い出すことが できなくなりますが 技を 忘れることを おすすめします
descriptions.hgss: The user soaks itself with water. The move weakens Fire-type moves while the user is in the battle.

effect.short: Halves all Fire-type damage.
effect.full: Fire moves inflict half damage, regardless of target. If the user leaves the field, this effect ends.

descriptions.zh: 静心凝神， 从而提高自己的特攻和特防。
descriptions.ja: 静かに 精神を 統一し 心を 鎮めることで 自分の 特攻と 特防を あげる。
descriptions.hgss: The user quietly focuses its mind and calms its spirit to raise its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.

effect.short: Raises the user’s Special Attack and Special Defense by one stage.
effect.full: Raises the user’s Special Attack and Special Defense by one stage each.

descriptions.zh: 像用剑一般操纵叶片 切斩对手进行攻击。 容易击中要害。
descriptions.ja: はっぱを 剣のように あやつり 相手を 切りつけて 攻撃する。 急所に 当たりやすい。
descriptions.hgss: The foe is slashed with a sharp leaf. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

effect.short: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

descriptions.zh: 激烈地跳起神秘 且强有力的舞蹈。 从而提高自己的攻击和速度。
descriptions.ja: 神秘的で 力強い 舞を 激しく おどる。 自分の 攻撃と 素早さを あげる。
descriptions.hgss: The user vigorously performs a mystic, powerful dance that boosts its Attack and Speed stats.

effect.short: Raises the user’s Attack and Speed by one stage.
effect.full: Raises the user’s Attack and Speed by one stage each.

descriptions.zh: 向对手发射 坚硬的岩石进行攻击。 连续攻击２～５次。
descriptions.ja: 硬い 岩石を 相手に 発射して 攻撃する。 ２ー５回の 間 連続で だす。
descriptions.hgss: The user hurls hard rocks at the foe. Two to five rocks are launched in quick succession.

effect.short: Hits 2-5 times in one turn.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Hits 2–5 times in one turn. Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use.

descriptions.zh: 向对手快速发出电击。 攻击必定会命中。
descriptions.ja: 電撃を 素早く 相手に 浴びせる。 攻撃は 必ず 命中する。
descriptions.hgss: The user strikes the foe with a quick jolt of electricity. This attack cannot be evaded.

effect.short: Never misses.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

descriptions.zh: 用水的震动攻击对手。 有时会使对手混乱。
descriptions.ja: 水の 振動を 相手に 与えて 攻撃する。 相手を 混乱させることが ある。
descriptions.hgss: The user attacks the foe with a pulsing blast of water. It may also confuse the foe.

effect.short: Has a chance to confuse the target.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to confuse the target.

descriptions.zh: 使用招式２回合后， 会用无数道光束攻击对手。
descriptions.ja: 技を 使った ２ターン後に 無数の 光の 束で 相手を 攻撃する。
descriptions.hgss: Two turns after this move is used, the user blasts the foe with a concentrated bundle of light.

effect.short: Hits the target two turns later.
effect.full: Inflicts typeless regular damage at the end of the third turn, starting with this one. This move cannot score a critical hit. If the target switches out, its replacement will be hit instead. Damage is calculated at the time this move is used; stat changes and switching out during the delay won’t change the damage inflicted. No move with this effect can be used against the same target again until after the end of the third turn. This effect breaks through Wonder Guard. If the target is protected by Protect or Detect on the turn this move is used, this move will fail. However, the damage on the third turn will break through protection. The damage is applied at the end of the turn, so it ignores Endure and Focus Sash. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move.

descriptions.zh: 无法使用这个招式。 虽然忘记之后就再也想不起来了， 但还是建议忘记这个招式。
descriptions.ja: この技は 使えません 思い出すことが できなくなりますが 技を 忘れることを おすすめします
descriptions.hgss: The user attacks the foe at full power. The attack’s recoil sharply reduces the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

effect.short: Lowers the user’s Special Attack by two stages after inflicting damage.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user’s Special Attack by two stages.

descriptions.zh: 降到地面，使身体休息。 回复自己最大ＨＰ的一半。
descriptions.ja: 地面に 降りて 体を やすめる。 最大ＨＰの 半分の ＨＰを 回復する。
descriptions.hgss: The user lands and rests its body. It restores the user’s HP by up to half of its max HP.

effect.short: Heals the user by half its max HP.
effect.full: Heals the user for half its max HP. If the user is Flying, its Flying type is ignored until the end of this turn.

descriptions.zh: 在５回合内，飘浮特性和飞行属性的 宝可梦会被地面属性的招式击中。 飞向空中的招式也将无法使用。
descriptions.ja: ５ターンの間 ふゆうや ひこうタイプに じめんタイプの 技が 当たるようになる。 空中に 飛ぶ 技も 使えない。
descriptions.hgss: Gravity is intensified for five turns, making moves involving flying unusable and negating Levitation.

effect.short: Disables moves and immunities that involve flying or levitating for five turns.
effect.full: For five turns (including this one), all immunities to Ground moves are disabled. For the duration of this effect, the evasion of every Pokémon on the field is lowered by two stages. Cancels the effects of Bounce, Fly, and Sky Drop. Specifically, Flying Pokémon and those with Levitate or that have used Magnet Rise are no longer immune to Ground attacks, Arena Trap, Spikes, or Toxic Spikes. Bounce, Fly, Sky Drop, High Jump Kick, Jump Kick, and Splash cannot be used while this move is in effect. *Bug*: If this move is used during a double or triple battle while Pokémon are under the effect of Sky Drop, Sky Drop’s effect is not correctly canceled on its target, and it remains high in the air indefinitely. As Sky Drop prevents the target from acting, the only way to subsequently remove it from the field is to faint it.

descriptions.zh: 无法使用这个招式。 虽然忘记之后就再也想不起来了， 但还是建议忘记这个招式。
descriptions.ja: この技は 使えません 思い出すことが できなくなりますが 技を 忘れることを おすすめします
descriptions.hgss: Enables the user to hit a Dark type with any type of move. It also enables the user to hit an evasive foe.

effect.short: Forces the target to have no evasion, and allows it to be hit by Psychic moves even if it’s Dark.
effect.full: Resets the target’s evasion to normal and prevents any further boosting until the target leaves the field. A Dark Pokémon under this effect takes normal damage from Psychic moves. This move itself ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

descriptions.zh: 无法使用这个招式。 虽然忘记之后就再也想不起来了， 但还是建议忘记这个招式。
descriptions.ja: この技は 使えません 思い出すことが できなくなりますが 技を 忘れることを おすすめします
descriptions.hgss: This attack inflicts high damage on a sleeping foe. It also wakes the foe up, however.

effect.short: If the target is asleep, has double power and wakes it up.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. If the target is sleeping, this move has double power, and the target wakes up.

descriptions.zh: 挥舞强力而沉重的拳头， 给予对手伤害。 自己的速度会降低。
descriptions.ja: 強くて 重い こぶしを ふるって ダメージを 与える。 自分の 素早さが さがる。
descriptions.hgss: The user swings and hits with its strong and heavy fist. It lowers the user’s Speed, however.

effect.short: Lowers user’s Speed by one stage.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user’s Speed by one stage.

descriptions.zh: 让身体高速旋转并撞击对手。 速度比对手越慢，威力越大。
descriptions.ja: 体を 高速に 回転させて 体当たりする。相手より 素早さが 低いほど 強い。
descriptions.hgss: The user tackles the foe with a high-speed spin. The slower the user, the greater the damage.

effect.short: Power raises when the user has lower Speed, up to a maximum of 150.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Power increases with the target’s current Speed compared to the user, given by `1 + 25 * target Speed / user Speed`, capped at 150.

descriptions.zh: 虽然自己陷入濒死， 但可以治愈后备上场的 宝可梦的异常状态以及回复ＨＰ。
descriptions.ja: 自分は ひんしに なるが 控えから でてくる ポケモンの 状態異常と ＨＰを 回復する。
descriptions.hgss: The user faints. In return, the Pokémon taking its place will have its HP restored and status cured.

effect.short: User faints. Its replacement has its HP fully restored and any major status effect removed.
effect.full: User faints. Its replacement’s HP is fully restored, and any major status effect is removed. If the replacement Pokémon is immediately fainted by a switch-in effect, the next replacement is healed by this move instead.

descriptions.zh: 当对手的ＨＰ 负伤到一半左右时， 招式威力会变成２倍。
descriptions.ja: 相手が ＨＰの 半分くらい きずを おっていると 技の 威力が ２倍に なる。
descriptions.hgss: If the foe’s HP is down to about half, this attack will hit with double the power.

effect.short: Has double power against Pokémon that have less than half their max HP remaining.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. If the target has less than half its max HP remaining, this move has double power.

descriptions.zh: 无法使用这个招式。 虽然忘记之后就再也想不起来了， 但还是建议忘记这个招式。
descriptions.ja: この技は 使えません 思い出すことが できなくなりますが 技を 忘れることを おすすめします
descriptions.hgss: The user draws power to attack by using its held Berry. The Berry determines its type and power.

effect.short: Power and type depend on the held berry.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Power and type are determined by the user’s held berry. The berry is consumed. If the user is not holding a berry, this move will fail.

descriptions.zh: 能够攻击正在使用 守住或看穿等招式的对手。 解除其守护效果。
descriptions.ja: まもるや みきり などを している 相手に 攻撃が できる。 守りの 効果を 解除させる。
descriptions.hgss: An attack that hits a foe using Protect or Detect. It also lifts the effects of those moves.

effect.short: Hits through Protect and Detect.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Removes the effects of Detect or Protect from the target before hitting. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move, nor selected by Assist or Metronome.

descriptions.zh: 用喙进行攻击。 当对手携带树果时， 可以食用并获得其效果。
descriptions.ja: くちばしで 攻撃。 相手が きのみを 持っているとき 食べて きのみの 効果を 受けられる。
descriptions.hgss: The user pecks the foe. If the foe is holding a Berry, the user plucks it and gains its effect.

effect.short: If target has a berry, inflicts double damage and uses the berry.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. If the target is holding a berry, this move has double power, and the user takes the berry and uses it immediately. If the target is holding a Jaboca Berry or Rowap Berry, the berry is still removed, but has no effect. If this move is super effective and the target is holding a berry that can reduce this move’s damage, it will do so, and will not be stolen.

descriptions.zh: 刮起猛烈的旋风， 在４回合内 提高我方全员的速度。
descriptions.ja: 激しく 吹きあれる 風の渦を つくり ４ターンの 間 味方 全員の 素早さを あげる。
descriptions.hgss: The user whips up a turbulent whirlwind that ups the Speed of all party Pokémon for three turns.

effect.short: For three turns, friendly Pokémon have doubled Speed.
effect.full: For the next three turns, all Pokémon on the user’s side of the field have their original Speed doubled. This effect remains if the user leaves the field.

descriptions.zh: 通过点穴 让身体舒筋活络。 大幅提高某１项能力。
descriptions.ja: つぼおしで 体を 活性化させる。 能力の どれか １つを ぐーんと あげる。
descriptions.hgss: The user applies pressure to stress points, sharply boosting one of its stats.

effect.short: Raises one of a friendly Pokémon’s stats at random by two stages.
effect.full: Raises one of the target’s stats by two stages. The raised stat is chosen at random from any stats that can be raised by two stages. If no stat is eligible, this move will fail. If the target has a Substitute, this move will have no effect, even if the user is the target. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move.

descriptions.zh: 使出招式前， 将最后受到的招式的伤害 大力返还给对手。
descriptions.ja: 技を だす前に 最後に 受けた 技の ダメージを 大きくして だした 相手に 返す。
descriptions.hgss: The user retaliates against the foe that last inflicted damage on it with much greater power.

effect.short: Strikes back at the last Pokémon to hit the user this turn with 1.5× the damage.
effect.full: Targets the last opposing Pokémon to hit the user with a damaging move this turn. Inflicts 1.5× the damage that move did to the user. If there is no eligible target, this move will fail. Type immunity applies, but other type effects are ignored.

descriptions.zh: 在攻击之后急速返回， 和后备宝可梦进行替换。
descriptions.ja: 攻撃したあと ものすごい スピードで もどってきて 控えの ポケモンと 入れ替わる。
descriptions.hgss: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

effect.short: User must switch out after attacking.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage, then the user immediately switches out, and the trainer selects a replacement Pokémon from the party. If the target faints from this attack, the user’s trainer selects the new Pokémon to send out first. If the user is the last Pokémon in its party that can battle, it will not switch out. The user may be hit by Pursuit when it switches out, if it has been targeted and Pursuit has not yet been used. This move may be used even if the user is under the effect of Ingrain. Ingrain’s effect will end.

descriptions.zh: 放弃守护， 向对手的怀里突击。 自己的防御和特防会降低。
descriptions.ja: 守りを 捨てて 相手の ふところに 突撃する。 自分の 防御と 特防が さがる。
descriptions.hgss: The user fights the foe up close without guarding itself. It also cuts the user’s Defense and Sp. Def.

effect.short: Lowers the user’s Defense and Special Defense by one stage after inflicting damage.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user’s Defense and Special Defense by one stage each.

descriptions.zh: 蓄力攻击。 如果能在对手之后攻击， 招式的威力会变成２倍。
descriptions.ja: ためこんで 攻撃する。 相手より あとに 攻撃できると 技の 威力は ２倍に なる。
descriptions.hgss: If the user can use this attack after the foe attacks, its power is doubled.

effect.short: Power is doubled if the target has already moved this turn.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. If the target uses a move or switches out this turn before this move is used, this move has double power.

descriptions.zh: 如果此回合内对手 已经受到伤害的话， 招式威力会变成２倍。
descriptions.ja: そのターンに 相手が すでに ダメージを 受けていたら 技の 威力は ２倍に なる。
descriptions.hgss: If the foe has already taken some damage in the same turn, this attack’s power is doubled.

effect.short: Power is doubled if the target has already received damage this turn.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. If the target takes damage this turn for any reason before this move is used, this move has double power.

descriptions.zh: 无法使用这个招式。 虽然忘记之后就再也想不起来了， 但还是建议忘记这个招式。
descriptions.ja: この技は 使えません 思い出すことが できなくなりますが 技を 忘れることを おすすめします
descriptions.hgss: It prevents the foe from using its held item. Its Trainer is also prevented from using items on it.

effect.short: Target cannot use held items.
effect.full: Target cannot use its held item for five turns. If the target leaves the field, this effect ends. If a Pokémon under this effect uses Bug Bite or Pluck on a Pokémon holding a berry, the berry is destroyed but not used. If a Pokémon under this effect uses Fling, it will fail. This effect is passed by Baton Pass.

descriptions.zh: 快速投掷携带的道具进行攻击。 根据道具不同， 威力和效果会改变。
descriptions.ja: 持たせた 道具を 素早く 投げつけて 攻撃する。 道具で 威力と 効果が 変わる。
descriptions.hgss: The user flings its held item at the foe to attack. Its power and effects depend on the item.

effect.short: Throws held item at the target; power depends on the item.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Power and type are determined by the user’s held item. The item is consumed. If the user is not holding an item, or its item has no set type and power, this move will fail. This move ignores Sticky Hold. If the user is under the effect of Embargo, this move will fail.

descriptions.zh: 利用超能力施以暗示， 从而将自己受到的异常状态 转移给对手。
descriptions.ja: 超能力で 暗示を かけて 自分の 受けている 状態異常を 相手に うつす。
descriptions.hgss: Using its psychic power of suggestion, the user transfers its status problems to the target.

effect.short: Transfers the user’s major status effect to the target.
effect.full: If the user has a major status effect and the target does not, the user’s status is transferred to the target.

descriptions.zh: 无法使用这个招式。 虽然忘记之后就再也想不起来了， 但还是建议忘记这个招式。
descriptions.ja: この技は 使えません 思い出すことが できなくなりますが 技を 忘れることを おすすめします
descriptions.hgss: The fewer PP this move has, the more power it has for attack.

effect.short: Power increases when this move has less PP, up to a maximum of 200.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Power is determined by the PP remaining for this move, after its PP cost is deducted. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. PP remaining | Power ------------ | ----: 4 or more | 40 3 | 50 2 | 60 1 | 80 0 | 200 If this move is activated by another move, the activating move’s PP is used to calculate power.

descriptions.zh: 无法使用这个招式。 虽然忘记之后就再也想不起来了， 但还是建议忘记这个招式。
descriptions.ja: この技は 使えません 思い出すことが できなくなりますが 技を 忘れることを おすすめします
descriptions.hgss: The user prevents the foe from using any HP-recovery moves for five turns.

effect.short: Prevents target from restoring its HP for five turns.
effect.full: For the next five turns, the target may not use any moves that only restore HP, and move effects that heal the target are disabled. Moves that steal HP may still be used, but will only inflict damage and not heal the target.

descriptions.zh: 无法使用这个招式。 虽然忘记之后就再也想不起来了， 但还是建议忘记这个招式。
descriptions.ja: この技は 使えません 思い出すことが できなくなりますが 技を 忘れることを おすすめします
descriptions.hgss: The user powerfully wrings the foe. The more HP the foe has, the greater this attack’s power.

effect.short: Power increases against targets with more HP remaining, up to a maximum of 121 power.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Power directly relates to the target’s relative remaining HP, given by `1 + 120 * current HP / max HP`, to a maximum of 121.

descriptions.zh: 利用超能力交换 自己的攻击和 防御的力量。
descriptions.ja: 超能力で 自分の 攻撃と 防御の 力を 交換する。
descriptions.hgss: The user employs its psychic power to switch its Attack with its Defense stat.

effect.short: User swaps Attack and Defense.
effect.full: The user’s original Attack and Defense are swapped. This effect is passed on by Baton Pass.

descriptions.zh: 将胃液吐向对手的身体。 沾上的胃液会消除 对手的特性效果。
descriptions.ja: 胃液を 相手の 体に 吐きつける。 ついた 胃液は 相手の 特性の 効果を 消す。
descriptions.hgss: The user hurls up its stomach acids on the foe. The fluid eliminates the effect of the foe’s ability.

effect.short: Nullifies target’s ability until it leaves battle.
effect.full: The target’s ability is disabled as long as it remains on the field. This effect is passed on by Baton Pass.

descriptions.zh: 无法使用这个招式。 虽然忘记之后就再也想不起来了， 但还是建议忘记这个招式。
descriptions.ja: この技は 使えません 思い出すことが できなくなりますが 技を 忘れることを おすすめします
descriptions.hgss: The user chants an incantation toward the sky, preventing the foe from landing critical hits.

effect.short: Prevents the target from scoring critical hits for five turns.
effect.full: For five turns, opposing Pokémon cannot score critical hits.

descriptions.zh: 无法使用这个招式。 虽然忘记之后就再也想不起来了， 但还是建议忘记这个招式。
descriptions.ja: この技は 使えません 思い出すことが できなくなりますが 技を 忘れることを おすすめします
descriptions.hgss: The user tries to cut ahead of the foe to steal and use the foe’s intended move with greater power.

effect.short: Uses the target’s move against it before it attacks, with power increased by half.
effect.full: If the target has selected a damaging move this turn, the user will copy that move and use it against the target, with a 50% increase in power. If the target moves before the user, this move will fail. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move, nor selected by Assist, Metronome, or Sleep Talk.

descriptions.zh: 模仿对手刚才使出的招式， 并使出相同招式。 如果对手还没出招则会失败。
descriptions.ja: 直前に でた 技を まねして 同じ 技を だす。 技が でていないと 失敗する。
descriptions.hgss: The user mimics the move used immediately before it. The move fails if no other move has been used yet.

effect.short: Uses the target’s last used move.
effect.full: Uses the last move that was used successfully by any Pokémon, including the user. This move cannot copy itself, nor Roar nor Whirlwind. This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move, nor selected by Assist, Metronome, or Sleep Talk.

descriptions.zh: 利用超能力互换 自己和对手的攻击 以及特攻的能力变化。
descriptions.ja: 超能力で 自分と 相手の 攻撃と 特攻の 能力変化を 入れ替える。
descriptions.hgss: The user employs its psychic power to switch changes to its Attack and Sp. Atk with the foe.

effect.short: User swaps Attack and Special Attack changes with the target.
effect.full: User swaps its Attack and Special Attack stat modifiers modifiers with the target.

descriptions.zh: 利用超能力互换 自己和对手的防御 以及特防的能力变化。
descriptions.ja: 超能力で 自分と 相手の 防御と 特防の 能力変化を 入れ替える。
descriptions.hgss: The user employs its psychic power to switch changes to its Defense and Sp. Def with the foe.

effect.short: User swaps Defense and Special Defense changes with the target.
effect.full: User swaps its Defense and Special Defense modifiers with the target.

descriptions.zh: 无法使用这个招式。 虽然忘记之后就再也想不起来了， 但还是建议忘记这个招式。
descriptions.ja: この技は 使えません 思い出すことが できなくなりますが 技を 忘れることを おすすめします
descriptions.hgss: This attack’s power increases the more the foe has powered up with stat changes.

effect.short: Power increases against targets with more raised stats, up to a maximum of 200.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Power starts at 60 and is increased by 20 for every stage any of the target’s stats has been raised, capping at 200. Accuracy and evasion modifiers do not increase this move’s power.

descriptions.zh: 当战斗中已学会的招式 全部使用过后， 才能开始使出珍藏的招式。
descriptions.ja: 戦闘中に おぼえている 技を すべて 使うと はじめて だせる とっておきの 技。
descriptions.hgss: This move can be used only after the user has used all the other moves it knows in the battle.

effect.short: Can only be used after all of the user’s other moves have been used.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. This move can only be used if each of the user’s other moves has been used at least once since the user entered the field. If this is the user’s only move, this move will fail.

descriptions.zh: 种植心神不宁的种子。 使对手不能入眠， 并将特性变成不眠。
descriptions.ja: 心を なやませる タネを 植えつける。 相手を 眠れなくして 特性を ふみんに する。
descriptions.hgss: A seed that causes worry is planted on the foe. It prevents sleep by making its ability Insomnia.

effect.short: Changes the target’s ability to Insomnia.
effect.full: Changes the target’s ability to Insomnia. If the target’s ability is Truant or Multitype, this move will fail.

descriptions.zh: 可以比对手先攻击。 对手使出的招式 如果不是攻击招式则会失败。
descriptions.ja: 相手より 先に 攻撃 できる。 相手が だす技が 攻撃技でないと 失敗する。
descriptions.hgss: This move enables the user to attack first. It fails if the foe is not readying an attack, however.

effect.short: Only works if the target is about to use a damaging move.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. If the target has not selected a damaging move this turn, or if the target has already acted this turn, this move will fail. This move is not affected by Iron Fist.

descriptions.zh: 在对手的脚下撒毒菱。 使对手替换出场的宝可梦中毒。
descriptions.ja: 相手の 足下に どくびしを しかける。 交代で でてきた 相手の ポケモンに 毒を おわせる。
descriptions.hgss: The user lays a trap of poison spikes at the foe’s feet. They poison foes that switch into battle.

effect.short: Scatters poisoned spikes, poisoning opposing Pokémon that switch in.
effect.full: Scatters poisoned spikes around the opposing field, which poison opposing Pokémon that enter the field. A second layer of these spikes may be laid down, in which case Pokémon will be badly poisoned instead. Pokémon immune to either Ground moves or being poisoned are immune to this effect. Pokémon otherwise immune to Ground moves are affected during Gravity. If a Poison Pokémon not immune to Ground moves enters a field covered with poisoned spikes, the spikes are removed. Rapid Spin will remove this effect from its user’s side of the field. Defog will remove this effect from its target’s side of the field. This move does not trigger Synchronize, unless the Pokémon with Synchronize was forced to enter the field by another effect such as Roar. Pokémon entering the field due to Baton Pass are not affected by this effect.

descriptions.zh: 无法使用这个招式。 虽然忘记之后就再也想不起来了， 但还是建议忘记这个招式。
descriptions.ja: この技は 使えません 思い出すことが できなくなりますが 技を 忘れることを おすすめします
descriptions.hgss: The user employs its psychic power to switch stat changes with the foe.

effect.short: User and target swap stat changes.
effect.full: User swaps its stat modifiers with the target.

descriptions.zh: 在自己身体的周围 覆盖用水制造的幕。 每回合回复ＨＰ。
descriptions.ja: 自分の 体の 周りを 水で つくった ベールで おおう。 毎ターン ＨＰを 回復する。
descriptions.hgss: The user envelops itself in a veil made of water. It regains some HP on every turn.

effect.short: Restores 1/16 of the user’s max HP each turn.
effect.full: Restores 1/16 of the user’s max HP at the end of each turn. If the user leaves the field, this effect ends. This effect is passed on by Baton Pass.

descriptions.zh: 利用电气产生的磁力浮在空中。 在５回合内可以飘浮。
descriptions.ja: 電気で つくった 磁力の 力で 宙に 浮かぶ。 ５ターンの 間 浮遊できる。
descriptions.hgss: The user levitates using electrically generated magnetism for five turns.

effect.short: User is immune to Ground moves and effects for five turns.
effect.full: For five turns, the user is immune to Ground moves. If the user is under the effect of Ingrain or has Levitate, this move will fail. This effect is temporarily disabled by and cannot be used during Gravity. This effect is passed on by Baton Pass.

descriptions.zh: 让火焰覆盖全身猛撞向对手。 自己也会受到不小的伤害。 有时会让对手陷入灼伤状态。
descriptions.ja: 炎を まとって 突進する。 自分も かなり ダメージを 受ける。 やけど状態に することが ある。
descriptions.hgss: The user cloaks itself in fire and charges at the foe. The user sustains serious damage, too.

effect.short: User takes 1/3 the damage inflicted in recoil. Has a chance to burn the target.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. User takes 1/3 the damage it inflicts in recoil. Has a chance to burn the target. Frozen Pokémon may use this move, in which case they will thaw.

descriptions.zh: 向对手的身体 发出冲击波进行攻击。 有时会让对手陷入麻痹状态。
descriptions.ja: 相手の 体に 衝撃波を 当てて 攻撃する。 まひ状態に することが ある。
descriptions.hgss: The foe is attacked with a shock wave. It may also leave the target paralyzed.

effect.short: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target.

descriptions.zh: 从体内产生出波导之力， 然后向对手发出。 攻击必定会命中。
descriptions.ja: 体の 奥から 波導の 力を 相手に うち放つ。 攻撃は 必ず 命中する。
descriptions.hgss: The user looses a blast of aura power from deep within its body. This move is certain to hit.

effect.short: Never misses.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

descriptions.zh: 打磨自己的身体， 减少空气阻力。 可以大幅提高自己的速度。
descriptions.ja: 自分の 体を 磨いて 空気の 抵抗を 少なくする。素早さを ぐーんと あげることが できる。
descriptions.hgss: The user polishes its body to reduce drag. It can sharply raise the Speed stat.

effect.short: Raises the user’s Speed by two stages.
effect.full: Raises the user’s Speed by two stages.

descriptions.zh: 用带毒的触手或手臂刺入对手。 有时会让对手陷入中毒状态。
descriptions.ja: 毒に そまった 触手や 腕で 相手を 突き刺す。 毒状態に することが ある。
descriptions.hgss: The foe is stabbed with a tentacle or arm steeped in poison. It may also poison the foe.

effect.short: Has a chance to poison the target.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to poison the target.

descriptions.zh: 从体内发出 充满恶意的恐怖气场。 有时会使对手畏缩。
descriptions.ja: 体から 悪意に みちた 恐ろしい オーラを 発する。 相手を ひるませることが ある。
descriptions.hgss: The user releases a horrible aura imbued with dark thoughts. It may also make the target flinch.

effect.short: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

descriptions.zh: 抓住瞬间的空隙 切斩对手。 容易击中要害。
descriptions.ja: 一瞬の すきを ついて 相手を 切りはらう。 急所に 当たりやすい。
descriptions.hgss: The user slashes the foe the instant an opportunity arises. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

effect.short: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

descriptions.zh: 如惊涛骇浪般挥动 大尾巴攻击对手。
descriptions.ja: 激しく あれくるう 荒波の ように 大きな しっぽを ふって 相手を 攻撃する。
descriptions.hgss: The user attacks by swinging its tail as if it were a vicious wave in a raging storm.

effect.short: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage.

descriptions.zh: 将外壳坚硬的大种子， 从上方砸下攻击对手。
descriptions.ja: 硬い 殻を もつ 大きな タネを 上から たたきつけて 相手を 攻撃する。
descriptions.hgss: The user slams a barrage of hard- shelled seeds down on the foe from above.

effect.short: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage.

descriptions.zh: 用连天空也能劈开的 空气之刃进行攻击。 有时会使对手畏缩。
descriptions.ja: 空をも 切り裂く 空気の 刃で 攻撃する。 相手を ひるませることが ある。
descriptions.hgss: The user attacks with a blade of air that slices even the sky. It may also make the target flinch.

effect.short: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

descriptions.zh: 将镰刀或爪子像剪刀般地交叉， 顺势劈开对手。
descriptions.ja: カマや ツメを ハサミのように 交差させながら 相手を 切り裂く。
descriptions.hgss: The user slashes at the foe by crossing its scythes or claws as if they were a pair of scissors.

effect.short: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage.

descriptions.zh: 利用振动发出音波进行攻击。 有时会降低对手的特防。
descriptions.ja: 振動で 音波を おこして 攻撃する。相手の 特防を さげることが ある。
descriptions.hgss: The user vibrates its wings to generate a damaging sound wave. It may also lower the foe’s Sp. Def stat.

effect.short: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.

descriptions.zh: 从大大的口中 掀起冲击波攻击对手。
descriptions.ja: 大きな 口から 衝撃波を まきおこして 相手を 攻撃する。
descriptions.hgss: The foe is attacked with a shock wave generated by the user’s gaping mouth.

effect.short: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage.

descriptions.zh: 释放出骇人的杀气， 一边威慑一边撞击对手。 有时会使对手畏缩。
descriptions.ja: すさまじい 殺気で 威圧しながら 体当たりする。 相手を ひるませることが ある。
descriptions.hgss: The user tackles the foe while exhibiting overwhelming menace. It may also make the target flinch.

effect.short: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

descriptions.zh: 发射如宝石般 闪耀的光芒攻击对手。
descriptions.ja: 宝石のように きらめく 光を 発射して 相手を 攻撃する。
descriptions.hgss: The user attacks with a ray of light that sparkles as if it were made of gemstones.

effect.short: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage.

descriptions.zh: 用拳头吸取对手的力量。 可以回复给予对手 伤害的一半ＨＰ。
descriptions.ja: こぶしから 相手の 力を 吸い取る。 与えた ダメージの 半分の ＨＰを 回復できる。
descriptions.hgss: An energy-draining punch. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

effect.short: Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.

descriptions.zh: 挥动拳头， 掀起真空波。 必定能够先制攻击。
descriptions.ja: こぶしを ふって 真空の 波を まきおこす。 必ず 先制攻撃できる。
descriptions.hgss: The user whirls its fists to send a wave of pure vacuum at the foe. This move always goes first.

effect.short: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage.

descriptions.zh: 提高气势， 释放出全部力量。 有时会降低对手的特防。
descriptions.ja: 気合を 高めて ありったけの 力を 放出する。 相手の 特防を さげることが ある。
descriptions.hgss: The user heightens its mental focus and unleashes its power. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Def.

effect.short: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.

descriptions.zh: 发射从自然收集的生命力量。 有时会降低对手的特防。
descriptions.ja: 自然から 集めた 命の力を 発射する。 相手の 特防を さげることがある。
descriptions.hgss: The user draws power from nature and fires it at the foe. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Def.

effect.short: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.

descriptions.zh: 收拢翅膀， 通过低空飞行突击对手。 自己也会受到不小的伤害。
descriptions.ja: はねを おりたたみ 低空飛行で 突撃する。 自分も かなり ダメージを 受ける。
descriptions.hgss: The user tucks in its wings and charges from a low altitude. The user also takes serious damage.

effect.short: User receives 1/3 the damage inflicted in recoil.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. User takes 1/3 the damage it inflicts in recoil.

descriptions.zh: 向对手脚下 释放出大地之力。 有时会降低对手的特防。
descriptions.ja: 相手の 足下へ 大地の力を 放出する。相手の 特防を さげることが ある。
descriptions.hgss: The user makes the ground under the foe erupt with power. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Def.

effect.short: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.

descriptions.zh: 用一闪而过的速度 交换自己和对手的持有物。
descriptions.ja: 目にも とまらぬ 速さで 自分と 相手の 持ち物を 交換する。
descriptions.hgss: The user trades held items with the foe faster than the eye can follow.

effect.short: User and target swap items.
effect.full: User and target permanently swap held items. Works even if one of the Pokémon isn’t holding anything. If either Pokémon is holding mail, this move will fail. If either Pokémon has Multitype or Sticky Hold, this move will fail. If this move results in a Pokémon obtaining Choice Band, Choice Scarf, or Choice Specs, and that Pokémon was the latter of the pair to move this turn, then the move it used this turn becomes its chosen forced move. This applies even if both Pokémon had a choice item before this move was used. If the first of the two Pokémon gains a choice item, it may select whatever choice move it wishes next turn. Neither the user nor the target can recover its item with Recycle. This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome.

descriptions.zh: 使出自己浑身力量突击对手。 下一回合自己将无法动弹。
descriptions.ja: 持てる 力を すべて 使って 相手に 突撃する。 次の ターンは 動けなくなる。
descriptions.hgss: The user charges at the foe using every bit of its power. The user must rest on the next turn.

effect.short: User foregoes its next turn to recharge.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. User loses its next turn to "recharge", and cannot attack or switch out during that turn.

descriptions.zh: 谋划诡计，激活头脑。 大幅提高自己的特攻。
descriptions.ja: 悪いことを 考えて 頭を 活性化させる。 自分の 特攻を ぐーんと あげる。
descriptions.hgss: The user stimulates its brain by thinking bad thoughts. It sharply raises the user’s Sp. Atk.

effect.short: Raises the user’s Special Attack by two stages.
effect.full: Raises the user’s Special Attack by two stages.

descriptions.zh: 向对手使出如子弹般 快速而坚硬的拳头。 必定能够先制攻击。
descriptions.ja: 弾丸の ような 速くて 硬い パンチを 相手に くりだす。 必ず 先制攻撃 できる。
descriptions.hgss: The user strikes with a tough punch as fast as a bullet. This move always goes first.

effect.short: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage.

descriptions.zh: 如果受到对手的招式攻击， 就能给予该对手 ２倍威力的攻击。
descriptions.ja: 相手から 技を 受けていると その 相手に 対して 技の 威力が ２倍に なる。
descriptions.hgss: An attack move that inflicts double the damage if the user has been hurt by the foe in the same turn.

effect.short: Inflicts double damage if the user takes damage before attacking this turn.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. If the target damaged the user this turn and was the last to do so, this move has double power. Pain Split does not count as damaging the user.

descriptions.zh: 瞬间制作冰块， 快速地扔向对手。 必定能够先制攻击。
descriptions.ja: 氷の塊を 一瞬で つくり 相手に 素早く 放つ。 必ず 先制攻撃 できる。
descriptions.hgss: The user flash freezes chunks of ice and hurls them. This move always goes first.

effect.short: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage.

descriptions.zh: 以影子做成的锐爪， 劈开对手。 容易击中要害。
descriptions.ja: 影から つくった 鋭い ツメで 相手を 切り裂く。 急所に 当たりやすい。
descriptions.hgss: The user slashes with a sharp claw made from shadows. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

effect.short: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

descriptions.zh: 用蓄满电流的牙齿咬住对手。 有时会使对手畏缩 或陷入麻痹状态。
descriptions.ja: 電気を ためた キバで かみつく。 相手を ひるませたり まひ状態に することが ある。
descriptions.hgss: The user bites with electrified fangs. It may also make the foe flinch or become paralyzed.

effect.short: Has a chance to paralyze the target and a chance to make the target flinch.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target and a separate chance to make the target flinch.

descriptions.zh: 用藏有冷气的牙齿咬住对手。 有时会使对手畏缩 或陷入冰冻状态。
descriptions.ja: 冷気を ひめた キバで かみつく。 相手を ひるませたり こおり状態に することが ある。
descriptions.hgss: The user bites with cold-infused fangs. It may also make the foe flinch or freeze.

effect.short: Has a chance to freeze the target and a chance to make the target flinch.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to freeze the target and a separate chance to make the target flinch.

descriptions.zh: 用覆盖着火焰的牙齿咬住对手。 有时会使对手畏缩 或陷入灼伤状态。
descriptions.ja: 炎を まとった キバで かみつく。 相手を ひるませたり やけど状態に することが ある。
descriptions.hgss: The user bites with flame-cloaked fangs. It may also make the foe flinch or sustain a burn.

effect.short: Has a chance to burn the target and a chance to make the target flinch.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target and a separate chance to make the target flinch.

descriptions.zh: 伸长影子， 从对手的背后进行攻击。 必定能够先制攻击。
descriptions.ja: 影を のばして 相手の 背後から 攻撃する。 必ず 先制攻撃 できる。
descriptions.hgss: The user extends its shadow and attacks the foe from behind. This move always goes first.

effect.short: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage.

descriptions.zh: 无法使用这个招式。 虽然忘记之后就再也想不起来了， 但还是建议忘记这个招式。
descriptions.ja: この技は 使えません 思い出すことが できなくなりますが 技を 忘れることを おすすめします
descriptions.hgss: The user launches a hard-packed mud ball to attack. It may also lower the target’s accuracy.

effect.short: Has a chance to lower the target’s accuracy by one stage.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s accuracy by one stage.

descriptions.zh: 用实体化的 心之利刃劈开对手。 容易击中要害。
descriptions.ja: 実体化させた 心の 刃で 相手を 切り裂く。 急所に 当たりやすい。
descriptions.hgss: The user tears at the foe with blades formed by psychic power. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

effect.short: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

descriptions.zh: 将思念的力量集中在 前额进行攻击。 有时会使对手畏缩。
descriptions.ja: 思念の 力を 額に 集めて 攻撃する。 相手を ひるませることが ある。
descriptions.hgss: The user focuses its willpower to its head and rams the foe. It may also make the target flinch.

effect.short: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

descriptions.zh: 无法使用这个招式。 虽然忘记之后就再也想不起来了， 但还是建议忘记这个招式。
descriptions.ja: この技は 使えません 思い出すことが できなくなりますが 技を 忘れることを おすすめします
descriptions.hgss: The user looses a flash of energy from its polished body. It may also lower the target’s accuracy.

effect.short: Has a chance to lower the target’s accuracy by one stage.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s accuracy by one stage.

descriptions.zh: 将身体的光芒 聚集在一点释放出去。 有时会降低对手的特防。
descriptions.ja: 体の 光を 一点に 集めて 力を 放つ。 相手の 特防を さげることが ある。
descriptions.hgss: The user gathers all its light energy and releases it at once. It may also lower the foe’s Sp. Def stat.

effect.short: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.

descriptions.zh: 无法使用这个招式。 虽然忘记之后就再也想不起来了， 但还是建议忘记这个招式。
descriptions.ja: この技は 使えません 思い出すことが できなくなりますが 技を 忘れることを おすすめします
descriptions.hgss: A charging attack that may also leave the foe confused. It can also be used to scale rocky walls.

effect.short: Has a chance to confuse the target.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to confuse the target.

descriptions.zh: 用强风吹开对手的 反射壁或光墙等。 也会降低对手的闪避率。
descriptions.ja: 強い風で 相手の リフレクターや ひかりのかべ などを はらいのける。 回避率も さげる。
descriptions.hgss: It reduces the foe’s evasion stat. It also removes spikes, light screens, etc.

effect.short: Lowers the target’s evasion by one stage. Removes field effects from the enemy field.
effect.full: Lowers the target’s evasion by one stage. Clears away fog. Removes the effects of Mist, Light Screen, Reflect, Safeguard, Spikes, Stealth Rock, and Toxic Spikes from the target’s side of the field. If the target is protected by Mist, it will prevent the evasion change, then be removed by this move.

descriptions.zh: 制造出离奇的空间。 在５回合内 速度慢的宝可梦可以先行动。
descriptions.ja: まか不思議な 空間を つくる。 ５ターンの 間 遅い ポケモンから 行動できる。
descriptions.hgss: The user creates a bizarre area in which slower Pokémon get to move first for five turns.

effect.short: For five turns, slower Pokémon will act before faster Pokémon.
effect.full: For five turns (including this one), slower Pokémon will act before faster Pokémon. Move priority is not affected. Using this move when its effect is already active will end the effect. Pokémon holding Full Incense, Lagging Tail, or Quick Claw and Pokémon with Stall ignore this effect.

descriptions.zh: 从天空中向对手落下陨石。 使用之后因为反作用力， 自己的特攻会大幅降低。
descriptions.ja: 天空から 隕石を 相手に 落とす。使うと 反動で 自分の 特攻が がくっと さがる。
descriptions.hgss: Comets are summoned down from the sky. The attack’s recoil sharply reduces the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

effect.short: Lowers the user’s Special Attack by two stages after inflicting damage.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user’s Special Attack by two stages.

descriptions.zh: 用耀眼的电击 攻击自己周围所有的宝可梦。 有时会陷入麻痹状态。
descriptions.ja: まばゆい 電撃で 自分の 周りに いるものを 攻撃する。 まひ状態に することが ある。
descriptions.hgss: A flare of electricity is loosed to strike all Pokémon in battle. It may also cause paralysis.

effect.short: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target.

descriptions.zh: 用熊熊烈火 攻击自己周围所有的宝可梦。 有时会陷入灼伤状态。
descriptions.ja: 真っ赤な 炎で 自分の 周りに いるものを 攻撃する。 やけど状態に することが ある。
descriptions.hgss: An inferno of scarlet flames washes over all Pokémon in battle. It may also inflict burns.

effect.short: Has a chance to burn the target.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target.

descriptions.zh: 用尖尖的叶片向对手卷起风暴。 使用之后因为反作用力 自己的特攻会大幅降低。
descriptions.ja: とがった はっぱで 相手に あらしを おこす。使うと 反動で 自分の 特攻が がくっと さがる。
descriptions.hgss: A storm of sharp leaves is whipped up. The attack’s recoil sharply reduces the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

effect.short: Lowers the user’s Special Attack by two stages after inflicting damage.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user’s Special Attack by two stages.

descriptions.zh: 激烈地挥舞青藤或触手 摔打对手进行攻击。
descriptions.ja: ツタや 触手を 激しく ふるって 相手を たたきつけ 攻撃する。
descriptions.hgss: The user violently whirls its vines or tentacles to harshly lash the foe.

effect.short: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage.

descriptions.zh: 向对手发射 巨大的岩石进行攻击。 下一回合自己将无法动弹。
descriptions.ja: 巨大な 岩を 相手に 発射して 攻撃する。 次の ターンは 動けなくなる。
descriptions.hgss: The user launches a huge boulder at the foe to attack. It must rest on the next turn, however.

effect.short: User foregoes its next turn to recharge.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. User loses its next turn to "recharge", and cannot attack or switch out during that turn.

descriptions.zh: 用毒刃劈开对手。 有时会让对手陷入中毒状态， 也容易击中要害。
descriptions.ja: 毒の 刃で 相手を 切り裂く。 毒状態に することが あり 急所にも 当たりやすい。
descriptions.hgss: A slashing attack that may also leave the target poisoned. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

effect.short: Has an increased chance for a critical hit and a chance to poison the target.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move. Has a chance to poison the target.

descriptions.zh: 用肮脏的垃圾 撞向对手进行攻击。 有时会让对手陷入中毒状态。
descriptions.ja: 汚い ゴミを 相手に ぶつけて 攻撃する。 毒状態に することが ある。
descriptions.hgss: The user shoots filthy garbage at the foe to attack. It may also poison the target.

effect.short: Has a chance to poison the target.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to poison the target.

descriptions.zh: 用钢铁般 坚硬的头部进行攻击。 有时会使对手畏缩。
descriptions.ja: 鋼の ような 硬い 頭で 攻撃する。 相手を ひるませることが ある。
descriptions.hgss: The foe slams the target with its steel-hard head. It may also make the target flinch.

effect.short: Has a chance to make the target flinch.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

descriptions.zh: 无法使用这个招式。 虽然忘记之后就再也想不起来了， 但还是建议忘记这个招式。
descriptions.ja: この技は 使えません 思い出すことが できなくなりますが 技を 忘れることを おすすめします
descriptions.hgss: The user launches a steel bomb that sticks to the target. This attack will not miss.

effect.short: Never misses.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

descriptions.zh: 用尖尖的岩石 刺入对手进行攻击。 容易击中要害。
descriptions.ja: とがった 岩を 相手に 突き刺して 攻撃する。 急所に 当たりやすい。
descriptions.hgss: The user stabs the foe with a sharpened stone. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

effect.short: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

descriptions.zh: 无法使用这个招式。 虽然忘记之后就再也想不起来了， 但还是建议忘记这个招式。
descriptions.ja: この技は 使えません 思い出すことが できなくなりますが 技を 忘れることを おすすめします
descriptions.hgss: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the foe is charmed into sharply lowering its Sp. Atk stat.

effect.short: Lowers the target’s Special Attack by two stages if it’s the opposite gender.
effect.full: Lowers the target’s Special Attack by two stages. If the user and target are the same gender, or either is genderless, this move will fail.

descriptions.zh: 将无数岩石悬浮在对手的周围， 从而对替换出场的对手的 宝可梦给予伤害。
descriptions.ja: 相手の 周りに 無数の 岩を 浮かべて 交代で でてきた 相手の ポケモンに ダメージを 与える。
descriptions.hgss: The user lays a trap of levitating stones around the foe. The trap hurts foes that switch into battle.

effect.short: Causes damage when opposing Pokémon switch in.
effect.full: Spreads sharp rocks around the opposing field, damaging any Pokémon that enters the field for 1/8 its max HP. This damage is affected by the entering Pokémon’s susceptibility to Rock moves. Rapid Spin removes this effect from its user’s side of the field.

descriptions.zh: 用草缠住并绊倒对手。 对手越重，威力越大。
descriptions.ja: 草を からませて 相手を 転ばせる。相手が 重いほど 威力が あがる。
descriptions.hgss: The user snares the foe with grass and trips it. The heavier the foe, the greater the damage.

effect.short: Inflicts more damage to heavier targets, with a maximum of 120 power.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Power increases with the target’s weight in kilograms, to a maximum of 120. Target’s weight | Power --------------- | ----: Up to 10kg | 20 Up to 25kg | 40 Up to 50kg | 60 Up to 100kg | 80 Up to 200kg | 100 Above 200kg | 120

descriptions.zh: 用非常烦人的， 喋喋不休的音波攻击对手。 使对手混乱。
descriptions.ja: とても うるさい おしゃべりの 音波で 相手を 攻撃する。 相手を 混乱させる。
descriptions.hgss: The user attacks using a sound wave based on words it has learned. It may also confuse the foe.

effect.short: Has a higher chance to confuse the target when the recorded sound is louder.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Has either a 1%, 11%, or 31% chance to confuse the target, based on the volume of the recording made for this move; louder recordings increase the chance of confusion. If the user is not a Chatot, this move will not cause confusion. This move cannot be copied by Mimic, Mirror Move, or Sketch, nor selected by Assist, Metronome, or Sleep Talk.

descriptions.zh: 向对手放出无数的光弹。 属性会根据自己 携带的石板不同而改变。
descriptions.ja: 無数の 光弾を 相手に 放出する。 自分の 持つ プレートに より タイプが 変わる。
descriptions.hgss: The user releases countless shots of light. Its type varies with the kind of Plate the user is holding.

effect.short: If the user is holding a appropriate plate or drive, the damage inflicted will match it.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. If the user is holding a plate or a drive, this move’s type is the type corresponding to that item. Note: This effect is technically shared by both Techno Blast and Judgment; however, Techno Blast is only affected by drives, and Judgment is only affected by plates.

descriptions.zh: 咬住进行攻击。 当对手携带树果时， 可以食用并获得其效果。
descriptions.ja: かみついて 攻撃する。 相手が きのみを 持っているとき 食べて きのみの 効果を 受けられる。
descriptions.hgss: The user bites the foe. If the foe is holding a Berry, the user eats it and gains its effect.

effect.short: If target has a berry, inflicts double damage and uses the berry.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. If the target is holding a berry, this move has double power, and the user takes the berry and uses it immediately. If the target is holding a Jaboca Berry or Rowap Berry, the berry is still removed, but has no effect. If this move is super effective and the target is holding a berry that can reduce this move’s damage, it will do so, and will not be stolen.

descriptions.zh: 向对手发射电击光束。 由于蓄满电流， 有时会提高自己的特攻。
descriptions.ja: 電撃の 束を 相手に 発射する。電気を ためて 自分の 特攻を あげることが ある。
descriptions.hgss: The user fires a concentrated bundle of electricity. It may also raise the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

effect.short: Has a chance to raise the user’s Special Attack by one stage.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to raise the user’s Special Attack by one stage.

descriptions.zh: 用坚硬的躯体 撞击对手进行攻击。 自己也会受到不小的伤害。
descriptions.ja: 硬い 胴体を 相手に たたきつけて 攻撃する。 自分も かなり ダメージを 受ける。
descriptions.hgss: The user slams its rugged body into the foe to attack. The user also sustains serious damage.

effect.short: User receives 1/3 the damage inflicted in recoil.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. User takes 1/3 the damage it inflicts in recoil.

descriptions.zh: 以迅雷不及掩耳之势 扑向对手。 必定能够先制攻击。
descriptions.ja: 目にも 留まらぬ ものすごい 速さで 相手に つっこむ。 必ず 先制攻撃 できる。
descriptions.hgss: The user lunges at the foe at a speed that makes it almost invisible. It is sure to strike first.

effect.short: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage.

descriptions.zh: 召唤手下， 让其朝对手发起攻击。 容易击中要害。
descriptions.ja: しもべを 呼びだして 相手に むかって 攻撃させる。 急所に 当たりやすい。
descriptions.hgss: The user calls out its underlings to pummel the foe. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

effect.short: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

descriptions.zh: 召唤手下， 让其附在自己的身体上。 可以提高自己的防御和特防。
descriptions.ja: しもべを 呼びだして 自分の 体に おおい つかせる。防御と 特防を あげることが できる。
descriptions.hgss: The user calls out its underlings to shield its body, raising its Defense and Sp. Def stats.

effect.short: Raises the user’s Defense and Special Defense by one stage.
effect.full: Raises the user’s Defense and Special Defense by one stage.

descriptions.zh: 无法使用这个招式。 虽然忘记之后就再也想不起来了， 但还是建议忘记这个招式。
descriptions.ja: この技は 使えません 思い出すことが できなくなりますが 技を 忘れることを おすすめします
descriptions.hgss: The user calls out its underlings to heal it. The user regains up to half of its max HP.

effect.short: Heals the user by half its max HP.
effect.full: Heals the user for half its max HP.

descriptions.zh: 拼命使出浑身力气， 向对手进行头锤攻击。 自己也会受到非常大的伤害。
descriptions.ja: 命を 懸けて こん身の 力で 相手に ずつきを する。 自分も ものすごい ダメージを 受ける。
descriptions.hgss: The user delivers a life-endangering attack at full power. The user also takes terrible damage.

effect.short: User receives 1/2 the damage inflicted in recoil.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. User takes 1/2 the damage it inflicts in recoil.

descriptions.zh: 使用尾巴等 拍打对手进行攻击。 连续２次给予伤害。
descriptions.ja: しっぽなどを 使い 相手を たたいて 攻撃する。 ２回連続で ダメージを 与える。
descriptions.hgss: The user slams the foe with a long tail, vines, etc. The target is hit twice in a row.

effect.short: Hits twice in one turn.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Hits twice in one turn.

descriptions.zh: 释放出扭曲时间般的 强大力量攻击对手。 下一回合自己将无法动弹。
descriptions.ja: 時間が ゆがむほどの 力を うちだして 相手を 攻撃する。 次の ターンは 動けなくなる。
descriptions.hgss: The user blasts the foe with power that distorts even time. The user must rest on the next turn.

effect.short: User foregoes its next turn to recharge.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. User loses its next turn to "recharge", and cannot attack or switch out during that turn.

descriptions.zh: 将对手连同周围的空间一起 撕裂并给予伤害。 容易击中要害。
descriptions.ja: 周りの 空間ごと 相手を 引き裂き ダメージを 与える。 急所に 当たりやすい。
descriptions.hgss: The user tears the foe along with the space around it. This move has a high critical-hit ratio.

effect.short: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

descriptions.zh: 虽然自己陷入濒死， 但可以治愈后备上场的 宝可梦的全部状态。
descriptions.ja: 自分は ひんしに なるが 控えから でてくる ポケモンの すべての 状態を 回復する。
descriptions.hgss: The user faints. In return, the Pokémon taking its place will have its status and HP fully restored.

effect.short: User faints, and its replacement is fully healed.
effect.full: User faints. Its replacement’s HP and PP are fully restored, and any major status effect is removed.

descriptions.zh: 用骇人的力量捏碎对手。 对手剩余的ＨＰ越多， 威力越大。
descriptions.ja: すさまじい 力で 相手を にぎりつぶす。 相手の ＨＰが 残っているほど 威力が あがる。
descriptions.hgss: The foe is crushed with great force. The attack is more powerful the more HP the foe has left.

effect.short: Power increases against targets with more HP remaining, up to a maximum of 121 power.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Power directly relates to the target’s relative remaining HP, given by `1 + 120 * current HP / max HP`, to a maximum of 121.

descriptions.zh: 将对手困在 熊熊燃烧的火焰中， 在４～５回合内进行攻击。
descriptions.ja: 激しく 燃えたぎる 炎の なかに ４ー５ターンの 間 相手を 閉じこめて 攻撃する。
descriptions.hgss: The foe becomes trapped within a maelstrom of fire that rages for two to five turns.

effect.short: Prevents the target from fleeing and inflicts damage for 2-5 turns.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. For the next 2–5 turns, the target cannot leave the field and is damaged for 1/16 its max HP at the end of each turn. The user continues to use other moves during this time. If the user leaves the field, this effect ends. Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use. Rapid Spin cancels this effect.

descriptions.zh: 将对手强制拖入黑暗的世界， 从而让对手陷入睡眠状态。
descriptions.ja: 暗黒の 世界に ひきずり 落として 相手を 眠り状態に する。
descriptions.hgss: The foe is dragged into a world of total darkness that puts it to sleep.

effect.short: Puts the target to sleep.
effect.full: Puts the target to sleep.

descriptions.zh: 从身体里产生冲击波。 有时会大幅降低对手的特防。
descriptions.ja: 体の 中から 衝撃波を 発生させる。相手の 特防を がくっと さげることが ある。
descriptions.hgss: The user generates a shock wave from within its body. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Def.

effect.short: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by two stages.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by two stages.

descriptions.zh: 无法使用这个招式。 虽然忘记之后就再也想不起来了， 但还是建议忘记这个招式。
descriptions.ja: この技は 使えません 思い出すことが できなくなりますが 技を 忘れることを おすすめします
descriptions.hgss: The user creates a gust of repulsive wind. It may also raise all the user’s stats at once.

effect.short: Has a chance to raise all of the user’s stats by one stage.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to raise all of the user’s stats one stage.

descriptions.zh: 第１回合消失踪影， 第２回合攻击对手。 即使对手正受保护，也能击中。
descriptions.ja: １ターン目で 姿を 消して ２ターン目に 相手を 攻撃する。 守っていても 攻撃は 当たる。
descriptions.hgss: The user disappears, then strikes the foe on the second turn. It hits even if the foe protects itself.

effect.short: User vanishes, dodging all attacks, and hits next turn. Hits through Protect and Detect.
effect.full: Inflicts regular damage. User vanishes for one turn, becoming immune to attack, and hits on the second turn. This move ignores the effects of Detect and Protect. This move cannot be selected by Sleep Talk.
